Existing methods that synthesize full cardiac sequences either rely on explicit ECG signals to parameterize myocardium function, or employ deformable registration without physiological constraints, failing to faithfully reproduce clinically relevant dynamic metrics such as ejection fraction (EF) and ventricular contraction magnitude. We present PhaseFlow, a unified generative framework that overcomes both limitations. PhaseFlow estimates a non-linear cardiac phase signal directly from the input sequence via a segmentation-derived left-ventricular (LV) area curve, capturing the asymmetric dynamics of systole and diastole without any ECG dependency. At inference, this phase signal is provided by a pathology-specific template, informing phase-specific frame generation. A rectified flow model conditioned on the phase and slice position synthesizes the full cardiac motion trajectory in the latent space, decoded into a diffeomorphic displacement field that warps end-diastole pixel intensities directly, eliminating the reconstruction blur often accompanying the variational autoencoder. On the ACDC benchmark, PhaseFlow achieves superior physiological fidelity and image realism, with best LV volume curve $R^2$, structural similarity (SSIM) and generative quality (FID) among all baselines. Ablation studies confirm that each proposed component contributes measurably to the overall performance.

</details>


### [47] [TiTok: Audio-Visual LLM for Multi-Segment Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09408)
*Eunji Shin,Dahyun Choi,Seungyeon Jo,Yejin Hong,Jiyoung Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 TiTok，一个用于音视频多段定位（AV-MSG）的 AV-LLM，通过时间 token 交织（TTI）实现精确边界预测，并用解耦多段奖励与 GDPO 优化，达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AV-MSG 要求在未剪辑视频中基于音视频证据为查询预测多个时间段，属基础且具挑战性的问题。纯视觉模型忽略互补的声学线索；音视频模型则常出现事件数量校准失败（count miscalibration），难以准确确定事件数目。

Method: 1) 提出 TiTok：音视频大语言模型，可为每个查询定位任意数量的时间段。2) 时间 token 交织（TTI）：将特殊时间 token 显式注入音视频流，对齐输入端时间感知与输出端时间预测，实现边界精确预测。3) 解耦的多段导向强化学习奖励：包含全局、局部、数量、精度、格式五类奖励，并用群体奖励解耦归一化策略优化（GDPO）进行优化。4) 建立基于 UnAV-100 的新评测协议，并提出 CountF1 指标量化重叠指标无法捕捉的数量校准问题。

Result: TiTok 取得 65.7 mIoU 和 0.58 CountF1，达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。

Conclusion: TiTok 通过 TTI 与解耦多段强化学习奖励有效解决 AV-MSG 中的边界与数量校准问题；配套的评测协议与 CountF1 指标为后续研究提供量化基准。

Abstract: Audio-visual multi-segment grounding (AV-MSG) in untrimmed videos, reasoning over audio-visual evidence and predicting multiple segments for a query, is a fundamental problem but remains challenging. Visual-only models overlook complementary acoustic cues, while audio-visual models often fail to calibrate the number of events - a phenomenon we refer to as count miscalibration. We present TiTok, an audio-visual large language model (AV-LLM) that localizes an arbitrary number of temporal event segments for each query. For precise boundary prediction, we introduce the Time Token Interleaving (TTI) method, which explicitly injects special time tokens into the audio-visual stream to align input-side temporal perception with output-side temporal prediction. We further propose decoupled, multi-segment-oriented rewards for reinforcement learning, consisting of global, local, count, precision, and format rewards, optimized with Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). To assess the performance on AV-MSG, we establish a new UnAV-100-based evaluation protocol, and propose the CountF1 metric for quantifying count miscalibration that overlap metrics fail to capture. TiTok reaches 65.7 mIoU and 0.58 CountF1, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Our code is available at this link.

</details>


### [48] [trACT: temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09417)
*Oliver Bimber,Rakesh John Amala Arokia Nathan,Mohamed Youssef,Vinayak Lal Bhatnagar,Ralf Berger,Klaus Hackländer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 trACT 框架，结合时序最大池化（TMP）与自监督运动异常检测，使消费级无人机可在复杂环境下实现轻量实时的自主目标验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机远程监控常受环境与热噪声、动态植被、目标伪装以及系统延迟干扰，难以从背景中辨识细微地面运动。受猛禽悬停并稳定视觉以捕捉地面细微运动的捕猎策略启发，作者希望弥补广域空中监控与精准自主目标验证之间的差距。

Method: trACT（temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap）是一个面向消费级无人机的轻量实时空中机器人框架：1）采用低层信号处理方法 Temporal Max Pooling（TMP），在滚动积分窗口内将难以察觉的运动转化为稳健的数值与时间编码；2）结合自监督运动异常检测，将目标运动与风阵、无人机漂移引起的背景环境运动分离；3）为克服机械与处理延迟，引入运动预测、自动云台稳定光学变焦验证以及公平的多目标验证均衡机制。

Result: 在植被茂密的野生动物栖息地与监控场景中开展了大量真实野外实验，结果表明 trACT 能够在严苛作业条件下成功弥合广域空中监控与精确自主目标验证之间的差距。

Conclusion: trACT 验证了生物启发式时序信号处理与自监督异常检测在消费级无人机平台上的有效性，为复杂环境下的自主空中监视与目标验证提供了轻量、实时的可行方案。

Abstract: Effective remote monitoring and surveillance using drones are frequently impeded by severe environmental and thermal clutter, dynamic vegetation, target camouflage, and system latency. Drawing inspiration from the hunting strategies of birds of prey that hover and stabilize their vision to isolate subtle ground motion, we introduce trACT (temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap), a lightweight, real-time aerial robotics framework designed for autonomous consumer drones. The system integrates Temporal Max Pooling (TMP), a low-level signal processing method that transforms imperceptible movement across a rolling integration window into robust value and time encodings, with self-supervised motion anomaly detection to isolate target motion from background environmental motion caused by wind gusts and drone drift. To overcome mechanical and processing delays, trACT combines motion prediction with automated gimbal-stabilized optical zoom verification and equitable multi-target verification balancing. Extensive real-world field experiments in densely forested wildlife habitats and surveillance scenarios demonstrate that trACT successfully bridges the gap between wide-area aerial monitoring and precise, autonomous target verification under challenging operational conditions.

</details>


### [49] [Spatial Latent Reasoning for Embodied Reference Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09418)
*Ling Li,Jianhui Zhong,Wei Liu,Zheng Jiang aand Yuxuan Liu,Jingyu Li,Zhidong Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Spatial Latent Reasoning (SLR) 框架，通过有序几何与视觉状态序列为指向手势视觉接地提供结构化监督，并引入 parity pooling 构建视觉目标，在 EgoPoint-Ground 与 YouRefIt 上均取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指向手势视觉接地需要将手部几何与所指对象的视觉身份和范围关联起来，而连续潜在推理的核心挑战在于如何把这些互补线索组织为有用的中间监督。作者希望以任务结构化的方式解决该问题。

Method: 提出 Spatial Latent Reasoning (SLR)，将监督围绕有序的几何与视觉状态序列进行组织：空间射线状态由指尖位置与指向方向监督，随后四个状态与目标区域特征对齐；为构建视觉目标，引入 parity pooling，通过多相分组在四个交错空间支撑上对区域 token 求平均。所有状态在训练和推理中循环生成，辅助标注仅在训练时使用。

Result: 在 EgoPoint-Ground 上，相比同骨干监督微调，mIoU 在 Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B 上分别提升 2.8、17.5、21.1 个百分点，且在两个困难子集上均有改善。在 YouRefIt 上，IoU 0.5 下达到 77.6% 精度，较报告的最新方法在不同评测协议下数值领先 5.2 个百分点。消融实验支持几何与视觉联合监督，并表明 parity pooling 优于三种替代池化算子。

Conclusion: 结果支持面向任务结构化的监督用于连续指向接地。作者将发布代码与支持材料。

Abstract: Pointing-gesture visual grounding requires connecting hand geometry with the visual identity and extent of a referred object. A central challenge for continuous latent reasoning is how to organize these complementary cues into useful intermediate supervision. We propose Spatial Latent Reasoning (SLR), a framework that structures this supervision around an ordered sequence of geometric and visual states. A spatial ray state is supervised by fingertip position and pointing direction, followed by four states aligned with target-region features. To construct the visual targets, we introduce parity pooling, which applies polyphase grouping to average region tokens on four interleaved spatial supports. All states are generated recurrently during training and inference; auxiliary annotations are required only during training. On EgoPoint-Ground, the framework improves mIoU over same-backbone supervised fine-tuning by 2.8, 17.5, and 21.1 percentage points on Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Qwen3-VL-8B, respectively, with improvements on both hard subsets. On YouRefIt, it achieves 77.6% precision at IoU 0.5, a numerical margin of 5.2 percentage points over the reported state of the art under differing evaluation protocols. Ablations support joint geometric and visual supervision on the standard and similar-object sets, and favor parity over three alternative pooling operators on the standard set. These results support task-structured supervision for continuous pointing grounding. We will release the code and supporting materials.

</details>


### [50] [Event-Aligned Visual Action Reasoning for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09427)
*Xiaomeng Yang,Yushu Wu,Yi Gao,Yuhao Lei,Xuan Zhang,Pu Zhao,Yanzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出事件对齐的视觉动作推理框架（WAM），按交互事件组织视觉想象与动作预测，并引入执行有效性头，DOMINO 成功率提升 10.26 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）按预设时间间隔构建视觉想象，未区分任务关键交互与连接过渡的不同作用，导致推理粒度与任务需求不匹配。

Method: 以交互事件为中心组织视觉-动作预测：通过事件对齐的视觉-动作监督，使模型在每次想象 rollout 中生成事件对齐的视觉上下文，对关键状态变化进行细粒度推理，对过渡阶段采用粗粒度推进；并引入执行有效性头，识别预测动作序列中的有效部分，避免分块推理时的冗余动作。

Result: 在 DOMINO 上成功率较基线提升 10.26 个百分点，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得有竞争力的性能；并可从 DOMINO Level 1 迁移至 Levels 2 和 3，无需目标层级适配。

Conclusion: 视觉前瞻应与任务相关交互及其推理需求对齐，事件对齐的推理粒度与执行有效性建模能有效提升动作生成质量与跨层级泛化能力。

Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) utilize future visual prediction as an intermediate reasoning process to guide action generation. However, existing WAMs typically structure visual imagination according to predefined temporal intervals, without explicitly accounting for the different roles of task-critical interactions and connecting transitions. We argue that effective visual foresight should align directly with task-relevant interactions and their corresponding reasoning demands. To this end, we introduce an event-aligned visual action reasoning framework that organizes visual-action prediction around interaction events. Through event-aligned visual-action supervision, WAM learns to generate event-aligned visual context in each imagined rollout, placing greater emphasis on critical state changes that inform action generation. This shapes the visual reasoning granularity according to the underlying interaction dynamics, with detailed reasoning around task-critical events and coarser progression through connecting transitions. Furthermore, we introduce an execution validity head that identifies the valid portion of each predicted action sequence, avoiding redundant actions during chunked inference. Experiments demonstrate a 10.26 percentage point improvement in DOMINO success rate over baseline and competitive performance on RoboTwin 2.0. It also transfers from DOMINO Level 1 to Levels 2 and 3 without target-level adaptation.

</details>


### [51] [SkillCycle: Co-Evolving Agent Policies and Skill Banks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09430)
*Ling Li,Qiuyu Shen,Zheng Jiang,Qinwei Ma,Yuxuan Liu,Zhidong Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SkillCycle通过技能内化与规则修订的反馈循环，实现智能体策略与技能库的共同演化，无需推理时技能输入即可提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言智能体在将外部技能内化后，其能力发生变化，导致剩余指导（规则）可能变得冗余、误导或不足以应对新决策。因此需要解决一个耦合问题：既要从技能中学习，又要根据能力变化不断调整用于监督后续学习的技能。

Method: 提出SkillCycle框架，让策略与技能库在"技能内化—规则修订"的反馈循环中共同演化。核心创新是赋予蒸馏反馈第二种作用：利用token级上下文差异定位需要审查的规则，同时用交互结果指导规则内容与适用范围的编辑。框架在两个阶段间交替：固定技能库与路由器下的策略学习，以及冻结策略下的规则修订。候选编辑在指导下轮学习前需经过规则级与整库级的环境比较。

Result: 在WebShop上，使用3B模型的SkillCycle在无推理时技能输入的情况下取得74.74%的成功率和88.37的分数，相对SOTA分别提升0.73%和3.96%。在ALFWorld和WebShop的第3轮消融中，SkillCycle的无技能成功率相对静态技能库分别提升10.18%和18.11%，相对单次技能库更新分别提升2.41%和2.50%。

Conclusion: 随着智能体能力变化而持续修订技能指导，有助于将外部技能转化为推理时无需技能输入的策略能力。作者将开源代码、配置、技能库和评估协议。

Abstract: Internalizing external skills changes a language agent's capabilities and, with them, the value of its remaining guidance: rules can become redundant, misleading, or insufficient for newly encountered decisions. This creates a coupled problem of learning from skills and adapting the skills that supervise further learning. We introduce SkillCycle, a framework for co-evolving agent policies and skill banks through a feedback loop between skill internalization and rule revision. Our central contribution is to give distillation feedback a second role: token-level contextual differences help locate rules for inspection, while interaction outcomes guide edits to their content and applicability. SkillCycle alternates between two phases: policy learning with a fixed skill bank and router, and rule revision with a frozen policy. Candidate edits undergo rule-level and whole-bank environment comparisons before they guide the next learning cycle. On WebShop, SkillCycle with a 3B model achieves a success rate of 74.74% and a score of 88.37 without inference-time skill inputs, representing relative improvements of 0.73% and 3.96% over the state-of-the-art (SOTA) model, respectively. In Cycle 3 ablations on ALFWorld and WebShop, SkillCycle's no-skill success rates improve by 10.18% and 18.11% relative to a static skill bank, and by 2.41% and 2.50% relative to a single bank update, respectively. These results show that continually revising skill guidance as the agent's capabilities change helps transform external skills into policy capabilities that require no skill inputs at inference. We will release code, configurations, skill banks, and evaluation protocols.

</details>


### [52] [Controllable Crowd Generation through World-Model Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09438)
*JunGyu Lee,Jisu Shin,Seunghyun Shin,Hae-Gon Jeon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Ctrl-CWM，一个结合人群生成与运行时控制的多智能体可控人群世界模型，可在不重训练的情况下适配用户新目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人群仿真在机器人导航、自动驾驶与城市规划中至关重要，需人群行为能适应环境变化与用户目标，但现有依赖预定义控制设置的方法灵活性不足，难以支持新的用户指定目标。

Method: 将"基于想象未来进行规划"的世界模型思想引入人群仿真：Ctrl-CWM 由编码器（学习人体运动动力学表征）、actor（生成行人位移）、critic（评估想象轨迹）与 planner（选择动作）组成。先用真实行人视频做轨迹预测学习运动动力学并冻结编码器，actor 通过重复状态更新生成想象中的轨迹，planner 结合 critic 分数与用户代价选择动作；重复规划推进仿真，新增用户代价即可引入控制目标而无需重训练。

Result: 在不同智能体到达条件下评估人群生成，并在避让与吸引场景中测试运行时控制；Ctrl-CWM 在多数人群真实感与碰撞指标上优于最先进方法，并能适配仿真过程中引入的用户目标。

Conclusion: Ctrl-CWM 通过世界模型式的想象规划实现可控人群仿真，验证了其真实性与可控性优势，为灵活的用户目标适配提供了新途径。

Abstract: Crowd simulation plays a central role in robot navigation, autonomous driving, and urban planning. For these applications, realistic simulation requires crowds to adapt their behavior to environmental changes and user objectives. However, existing methods that rely on predefined control settings have limited flexibility in accommodating new user-specified objectives. To address this limitation, we propose Ctrl-CWM, a multi-agent Controllable Crowd World Model that integrates crowd generation and run-time control. Our key idea is to adapt the world-model principle of planning using imagined futures to crowd simulation. To this end, Ctrl-CWM consists of an encoder that learns a representation of human motion dynamics, an actor that proposes pedestrian displacements, a critic that evaluates imagined crowd trajectories, and a planner that selects actions. We first learn human motion dynamics through trajectory prediction on real-world pedestrian videos and then freeze the encoder to preserve them. Using this representation, the actor generates imagined crowd trajectories through repeated state updates, and the planner combines the critic's scores with user costs to select actions. Repeated planning advances the simulated crowd, while additional user costs introduce new control objectives without retraining. We extensively evaluate crowd generation under varied agent arrival conditions and run-time control across avoidance and attraction scenarios. Ctrl-CWM outperforms the state-of-the-art method on most crowd realism and collision metrics, and adapts crowd behaviors to user-specified objectives introduced during simulation. The project page is available at https://jungyu0413.github.io/Ctrl-CWM

</details>


### [53] [InscriptionOCR: A Dataset and Method for Understanding Inscriptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09439)
*Jaidev Sanjay Khalane,Akbar Ali,V. N. Prabhakar,Shanmuganathan Raman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出端到端AI框架理解阿育王婆罗米文石刻，涵盖图像增强、OCR、转写和NMT，并发布两个数据集：超20万字符图像的OCR数据集和2000余句对的普拉克里特语-英语平行语料。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 古代石刻图像退化严重、缺乏标准化数字资源，阿育王婆罗米文虽含丰富历史数据但计算分析研究稀缺，自动化处理面临挑战。

Method: 构建端到端流水线：处理直接从石碑拍摄的低质量图像，依次进行图像修复与婆罗米文字符识别、字符到罗马字母的转写、普拉克里特语到英语的神经机器翻译。

Result: 发布两个数据集：(i) InscriptionOCR数据集，迄今最大公开可用的婆罗米文OCR数据集，含约600类、超200,000张字符图像；(ii) 超2,000句对的普拉克里特语-英语双语平行语料。

Conclusion: 该框架与数据集将促进古文字分析、低资源OCR及数字碑刻学等领域的未来研究。

Abstract: Ancient script image restoration is a fundamental problem in computer vision, as it directly affects the reliable analysis and interpretation of historical documents and inscriptions. Ashokan Brahmi is an ancient script extensively used during the reign of Emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BC, primarily for inscriptions in Prakrit. These inscriptions, including major and minor rock and pillar edicts, constitute a valuable yet largely unexplored source of data for computational analysis. The degraded nature of inscription imagery and the lack of standardized digital resources pose significant challenges for automated processing.
  We present an end-to-end AI-based framework for understanding ancient inscriptions that encompasses image enhancement, optical character recognition (OCR), transliteration, and neural machine translation (NMT). The proposed pipeline processes low-quality images captured directly from stone inscriptions, performs image restoration and Brahmi script character recognition, maps the recognized characters to the Roman script, and finally translates the resulting Prakrit text into English. We also introduce two new datasets: (i) InscriptionOCR Dataset: the largest publicly usable digital OCR dataset for Brahmi script to date, consisting of over 200,000 character images across about 600 classes, and (ii) a bilingual Prakrit-English parallel corpus comprising over 2,000 sentence pairs for NMT. We believe that the proposed framework and datasets will facilitate future research in ancient script analysis, low-resource OCR, and digital epigraphy.

</details>


### [54] [Mixture of Layers: Dynamic Layer Routing for Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09440)
*Jeonghwan Kim,Sofia Stoica,Jiwan Chung,Ansel Blume,Hyeonjeong Ha,Zhenhailong Wang,Xin Luna Dong,Heng Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Mixture of Layers (MoL)，一种指令条件下的视觉层路由方法，在 patch 级别对中间视觉编码器层进行 top-k 稀疏聚合，实现查询自适应的细粒度视觉表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 多依赖最后一层或倒数第二层视觉表征，或使用固定聚合规则，使视觉抽象与查询无关，难以获取小物体、空间细节、文字等细粒度线索。

Method: 给定文本查询，MoL 预测各视觉编码器层的路由概率，并在图像级、patch 级或混合路由机制下对选中的隐藏状态做 top-k 稀疏聚合，从而动态聚合查询相关的中间层潜在表征。

Result: 在 7 个细粒度视觉推理任务上显著提升：V* 总体准确率 +18.9%，HRBench4K +4.5%，CharXiv +16.3%，且未使用多分辨率输入、多编码器交织或增加 patch token 数。

Conclusion: 通过分析不同层的感受野尺度与采样行为，阐明层间采样有效的原因，表明条件化视觉表征是提升 MLLM 视觉感知与推理的关键一步。

Abstract: Pre-trained vision encoders contain layer-wise visual representations that differ in spatial granularity, semantic abstraction, and sensitivity to local details. However, most Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) rely on only the final or penultimate vision encoder representations or fixed aggregation rules, making visual abstraction largely query-agnostic and limiting access to fine-grained cues such as small objects, spatial details, text, and subtle visual attributes. In this work, we propose Mixture of Layers (MoL), an instruction-conditioned layer routing approach at the visual patch level that dynamically aggregates query-relevant latent representations from intermediate vision encoder layers. Given a text query, MoL predicts routing probabilities over vision encoder layers and performs a top-k sparse aggregation over selected hidden states at either the image level, patch level, or through a hybrid routing mechanism. In doing so, MoL enables query-adaptive access to layer-specific visual features for fine-grained visual reasoning. Our experiments across 7 fine-grained visual reasoning tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements, especially across fine-grained visual grounding and understanding tasks such as +18.9% improvement on V* in overall accuracy, +4.5% on HRBench4K, and +16.3% on CharXiv compared to the baseline MLLMs, without resorting to multi-resolution inputs, simple interleaving of multiple vision encoders, or increasing the number of patch tokens. We study vision encoders' receptive field scales across different layers and their sampling behaviors to provide an in-depth analysis of why layer-wise sampling is helpful, demonstrating that conditional visual representations are a key step towards better visual perception and reasoning in MLLMs. Our project page is available at https://wjdghks950.github.io/mol.github.io/.

</details>


### [55] [TIRA: Tumor Immune Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Cross-Cancer MSI and TMB Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09441)
*Dasari Naga Raju*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TIRA框架,利用空间免疫拓扑在无目标域数据条件下精炼冻结的病理基础模型表征,实现跨癌种MSI与TMB预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MSI-H与TMB-H是临床相关生物标志物,但模型在不同形态学癌种间迁移时预测困难。免疫相关空间模式可跨癌种保持,而单癌种训练的基础模型预测器未显式利用该信息,导致跨癌种泛化受限。

Method: TIRA(Tumor Immune Representation Adaptation)是一个无需目标域数据的框架:在模型开发与测试时自适应阶段均不依赖目标域数据,利用拓扑监督的生物学表征来调节tile级注意力,同时仅对形态学特征进行池化,用于MSI与TMB联合预测。在TCGA-COAD+READ上训练,在CPTAC-COAD、TCGA-STAD、TCGA-UCEC、CPTAC-UCEC上零样本评估,覆盖跨站点、跨癌种及联合分布偏移,并测试UNI2、CONCH、Virchow2三种基础模型。

Result: 在UNI2上,TIRA将TCGA-STAD零样本AUROC从0.633提升至0.766(MSI),从0.651提升至0.772(TMB)。

Conclusion: 源域衍生的空间免疫拓扑可提升冻结病理基础模型表征的跨癌种鲁棒性。

Abstract: Microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) and high tumor mutational burden (TMB-H) are clinically relevant biomarkers, yet their histopathological prediction remains challenging when models are transferred across morphologically distinct cancer types. Immune-associated spatial patterns can persist across cancers despite these morphological differences, but foundation-model-based predictors trained on a single cancer do not explicitly use this information, limiting cross-cancer generalization. To address this limitation, we propose TIRA (Tumor Immune Representation Adaptation), a target-free framework that refines frozen foundation-model representations using spatial immune topology, without requiring target-domain data during model development or test-time adaptation. TIRA uses a topology-supervised biology representation to condition tile-level attention while pooling only morphological features for joint MSI and TMB prediction. We train TIRA on TCGA-COAD+READ and evaluate it zero-shot on CPTAC-COAD, TCGA-STAD, TCGA-UCEC, and CPTAC-UCEC, covering cross-site, cross-cancer, and combined cross-cancer-site distribution shifts under UNI2, CONCH, and Virchow2. With UNI2, TIRA improved zero-shot AUROC on TCGA-STAD from 0.633 to 0.766 for MSI and from 0.651 to 0.772 for TMB. Source-derived spatial immune topology improved the cross-cancer robustness of frozen pathology foundation-model representations.

</details>


### [56] [LighTROcc: Lightweight 4D Occupancy Forecasting via Instance-Centric 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09444)
*Hwanhee Jung,SeungHyeon Kim,Inkyu Koo,Qixing Huang,Sang Ho Yoon,Sangpil Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LighTROcc是一个轻量化的以实例为中心的框架，用少量可学习query表示可移动物体，单次前向即预测当前与未来占用，在nuScenes上兼顾实例级预测精度与计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于环视相机的3D占用预测方法依赖稠密体素或鸟瞰图表示：其计算代价随空间分辨率和预测时域迅速增长；且这类表示不显式维持物体身份，难以在时间上保持实例一致性。

Method: 用紧凑的可学习query集合表示可移动物体；通过注意力引导的前向提升定位每个query，结合图像空间cross-attention、query-specific depth与相机几何估计其3D中心；将每个实例建模为各向异性3D高斯混合，并利用预测位移在未来时间步传播，生成连续且时间一致的占用预测。

Result: 在nuScenes及补充的nuScenes-Occupancy上，LighTROcc在实例级预测精度上优于所评估的稠密与实例级基线，同时保持较强的体素级占用质量；在不同模型配置下实现预测精度与计算效率的良好平衡。

Conclusion: 结果表明，紧凑的以实例为中心的建模方式在基于相机的4D占用预测中具有潜力。

Abstract: Forecasting future 3D occupancy from surround-view cameras is essential for autonomous driving, yet existing approaches rely on dense voxel or bird's-eye-view representations whose cost grows rapidly with spatial resolution and prediction horizon. Because these representations do not explicitly maintain object identities, they also struggle to preserve instance consistency over time. We present LighTROcc, a lightweight instance-centric framework that represents movable objects with a compact set of learned queries and predicts present and future occupancy in a single forward pass. LighTROcc localizes each query through attention-guided forward lifting, combining image-space cross-attention, query-specific depth, and camera geometry to estimate its 3D center. Each instance is modeled as a mixture of anisotropic 3D Gaussians and propagated across future steps using predicted displacements, producing continuous, temporally consistent occupancy forecasts. Experiments on nuScenes and supplemented nuScenes-Occupancy show that LighTROcc outperforms the evaluated dense and instance-wise baselines in instance-level forecasting accuracy while maintaining strong voxel-level occupancy quality. Across different model configurations, LighTROcc achieves a favorable balance between forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency, demonstrating the potential of compact instance-centric modeling for camera-based 4D occupancy forecasting.

</details>


### [57] [From Global Alignment to Local Grounding: Zero-Shot Chinese Character Recognition with Radical Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09449)
*Yu-Heng Shih,Bing-Chen Wu,Tsz-To Wong,Ting-En Yen,Hong-Han Shuai,Bin-Hua Hsieh,Chien-An Chen,Yi-Ren Yeh,Ching-Chun Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出全局到局部的两阶段零样本汉字识别框架，先以显式空间先验增强IDS做高召回全局检索，再用部首验证模块进行局部精排，ICDAR2013上以2755个可见类取得83.06%的top-1准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CLIP式方法用IDS表示汉字结构并与字形图像在共享空间对齐，但仅依赖单一全局图像-IDS相似度：一是丢弃了部首的空间布局信息，二是仅从可见类隐式学习，对未见类泛化差；三是当字符仅局部部首细微差异时，全局匹配常能在候选内召回正确字符却无法将其排到首位。

Method: 提出全局到局部的两阶段框架。第一阶段STG-CLIP在IDS中引入显式的树位置与部首级几何先验，生成空间感知原型，为可见与未见类别提供一致的空间描述以支持高召回全局检索；第二阶段部首验证模块RVM以每个召回候选的部首实例为查询，验证其能否匹配到输入字形中空间兼容的区域；并设计基于间隔的门控规则，仅在领先的全局候选得分相近时激活RVM。

Result: 在ICDAR2013基准上，字符级零样本设置下取得最优性能，使用2755个可见类达到83.06%的top-1准确率；消融实验表明显式几何先验与部首级验证带来互补的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过显式空间先验的全局检索与部首级局部验证相结合，可有效缓解全局图像-IDS匹配对空间布局的忽视及对未见类泛化不足的问题，提升零样本汉字识别的细粒度排序能力。

Abstract: Zero-shot Chinese character recognition (ZS-CCR) aims to recognize characters whose categories are never observed during training, and typically relies on the compositional structure shared between seen and unseen characters. Recent CLIP-style methods represent this structure with the Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) and align it with glyph images in a shared embedding space. However, they rely on a single global image--IDS similarity that discards the spatial layout of radicals and, being learned only implicitly from seen classes, generalizes poorly to unseen ones; moreover, global matching often retrieves the correct character within the top candidates yet fails to rank it first when characters differ only in subtle local radicals. To address these issues, we propose a global-to-local two-stage framework. In the first stage, STG-CLIP augments the IDS with explicit tree-position and radical-level geometric priors, yielding a spatial-aware prototype that provides a consistent spatial description across seen and unseen categories for high-recall global retrieval. In the second stage, the Radical Verification Module (RVM) uses the radical instances of each retrieved candidate as queries to verify whether the corresponding radicals can be matched to spatially compatible regions in the input glyph. A margin-based gating rule activates the RVM only when the leading global candidates receive similar similarity scores. Experiments on the ICDAR2013 benchmark demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance under the character-level zero-shot setting, obtaining 83.06% top-1 accuracy with 2,755 seen classes. Ablation studies further show that the explicit geometric priors and radical-level verification provide complementary improvements.

</details>


### [58] [Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space Diffusion Training, Conversion and Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09450)
*Hanqiu Li Cai,Chema Garabito*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作系统检验"像素空间扩散模型因省去有损VAE而在细粒度下游任务上更优"这一说法：从零预训练3B像素空间文生图Transformer Iris-3B，并将预训练潜空间模型FLUX.2 Klein 4B转换为像素空间，二者在单目深度估计与图像复原/超分上均未显著优于潜空间基线，但Iris-3B证明像素空间预训练可扩展至3B参数并达到与潜空间模型相当的文生图质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜空间扩散模型依赖有损VAE，理论上会在细粒度细节上造成信息损失，因此存在一种直觉：像素空间扩散模型在细节敏感的下游任务（如深度估计、超分/复原）上应具优势。本文旨在对这一常被默认接受但缺乏严格验证的假设进行实证检验，并同时厘清像素空间主干的可扩展性。

Method: 沿两条路径构建像素空间主干：(1) 从零预训练Iris-3B——一个3B参数的像素空间文生图Transformer，采用$256\to512\to1024$的课程式分辨率训练，并先在$256^2$下对预测目标与表示对齐进行消融以决定扩展对象；(2) 将预训练的潜空间模型FLUX.2 Klein base 4B转换为像素空间。随后对两个模型族在单目深度估计与图像复原/超分任务上微调，并在匹配的直接回归配方下与潜空间FLUX.2 Klein对比。

Result: 未发现使用像素空间生成先验带来显著提升：在单目深度估计上，采用同一匹配的直接回归配方微调后，Iris-3B与潜空间FLUX.2 Klein持平，而转换得到的像素空间FLUX.2 Klein落后于后者；在$4\times$ DIV2K图像复原上，两个像素模型均未超越微调后的潜空间FLUX.2 Klein，转换版本略逊一筹。作者并记录了相关配方、失败模式与残余混淆因素。另一方面，Iris-3B表明基于PixelDiT的像素Transformer（PiT）头进行像素空间预训练可扩展至3B参数，在$1024^2$下由官方评测器测得文生图质量与潜空间模型相当，在OneIG上与Qwen-Image持平。

Conclusion: 像素空间扩散模型在细粒度下游任务上的优势假设未获实证支持，去除VAE并不自动转化为下游收益；但像素空间预训练在3B规模下具备可扩展性与有竞争力的文生图质量。作者公开Iris-3B权重与训练代码，以期推动像素空间生成的后续研究，并强调需进一步厘清造成该负面结果的混淆因素。

Abstract: Pixel-space diffusion models avoid the lossy VAE of latent models, which suggests an advantage on downstream tasks where fine-grained detail matters. We test this claim along both routes to a pixel-space backbone. We pretrain Iris-3B, a 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image transformer, from scratch through a $256\to512\to1024$ curriculum, after first ablating the prediction target and representation alignment at $256^2$ to decide what to scale. We also convert a pretrained latent model, FLUX.2 Klein base 4B, to pixel space. We fine-tune both families for monocular depth estimation and for image restoration/super-resolution. We find no significant improvement from using a pixel-space generative prior. Fine-tuned for depth with one matched direct-regression recipe, Iris-3B is level with the latent FLUX.2 Klein and the converted pixel FLUX.2 Klein falls behind it, and on $4\times$ DIV2K restoration neither pixel model beats a latent FLUX.2 Klein fine-tune, the converted one trailing it slightly. We document the recipes, the failure modes and the remaining confounds behind this negative result. Nevertheless, Iris-3B shows that pixel-space pretraining with the pixel-transformer (PiT) head of PixelDiT scales to 3B parameters and to text-to-image quality competitive with latent models, matching Qwen-Image on OneIG under the official evaluators at $1024^2$. We release its weights and training code in the hope that they help pave the way for further work on pixel-space generation.

</details>


### [59] [RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09455)
*Seungjun Moon,Subin Jeon,Sangwoo Kim,Hanbyul Joo,Jinwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RLHND 是一个基于视频基础模型的手部追踪模型，从单目第一人称视频中联合估计手部姿态与真实触觉信息（接触与力），在姿态、接触和力的估计上均达到最先进水平，并展示了其在机器人学习中的应用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用人类视频数据集进行机器人策略训练日益流行，但现有手部追踪器多基于裁剪帧回归姿态，缺乏手部运动与物体交互的先验，估计不准确且物理不一致；同时缺少接触、力等物理线索，限制了人类视频在机器人策略训练中的使用。

Method: 提出 RLHND：将预训练的 Cosmos 3 视频扩散骨干网络通过干净潜变量条件化转为确定性的片段级特征提取器，继承其手部运动与手-物交互先验。姿态估计方面：(i) 预测符合解剖学合理关节角度的手部姿态；(ii) 可选地对形状参数进行条件化，使同一视频内乃至同一演员所录视频间手形一致。触觉估计方面：独立的触觉专家流在冻结姿态流的情况下训练，预测手表面上的稠密接触与力。并采用基于 LBS 的特征传播，实现无需昂贵的逐顶点注意力即可进行逐顶点特征提取。

Result: RLHND 在多个基准数据集的姿态估计上达到最先进性能，同时在接触和力估计上也达到最先进水平；并通过重定向结果与真实机器人实验证明了其在机器人学习中的实用性。

Conclusion: RLHND 通过视频基础模型联合估计手部姿态与触觉信息，克服了现有手部追踪器物理不一致、缺乏物理线索的缺陷，为利用人类视频进行机器人策略训练提供了有效工具，代码将公开。

Abstract: Recently, approaches that leverage human video datasets for robot policy training have become increasingly prevalent. However, most existing hand trackers regress pose from cropped frames with limited priors on hand motion and object interaction, resulting in inaccurate and physically inconsistent estimates. Moreover, the lack of physical cues, e.g., contact and force, limits the use of human videos for robot policy training. To this end, we propose RLHND, a video foundation model-based hand tracking model that jointly estimates hand pose and realistic tactile information from monocular egocentric videos. RLHND turns the pre-trained Cosmos 3 video diffusion backbone into a deterministic clip-level feature extractor via clean-latent conditioning, carrying its learned priors on hand motion and hand-object interaction into tracking. For pose estimation, RLHND (i) predicts hand poses with anatomically plausible joint angles and (ii) enables optional conditioning on the shape parameter to maintain consistent hand shape within the same video and even across videos recorded by the same actor. For tactile estimation, a separate tactile expert stream, trained with the pose stream frozen, predicts dense contact and force over the hand surface. We further adopt LBS-based feature spreading to enable vertex-wise feature extraction without costly per-vertex attention. RLHND achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmark datasets for pose estimation, while also achieving state-of-the-art performance in contact and force estimation. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of RLHND for robot learning through retargeting results and real-world robot experiments. The code will be publicly available at https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/.

</details>


### [60] [An Invariant Tangent-Angle Descriptor and a Band U-Net for 2D Fragment Adjacency Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09459)
*Guillaume Brouillette,Alain Goupil,Pierre-Olivier Parisé,Fadel Touré*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将碎片轮廓对的局部打分由图像窗口卷积比较替换为切角轮廓比较，并采用带状U-Net分割与分类，使方法具备旋转与起点不变性，在合成数据达98%准确率，并提升PairingNet基准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二维碎片配对的核心在于基于轮廓判定两碎片是否相邻。现有Beaulac两阶段架构依赖旋转等变孪生卷积网络对局部图像窗口打分，其表示对碎片旋转敏感、受轮廓起点影响，且最终分类器无法同时给出共享弧段，评估修正后精度存在提升空间。

Method: 保留两阶段流水线，将局部打分替换为轮廓窗口切角剖面的比较，构造上实现旋转不变与轮廓起点无关；该比较可选无训练似然比或小型一维卷积模型（在对应点上训练）。同时用带状U-Net替换最终分类器，对邻接矩阵中的带状区域进行分割并判定配对，从而在给出决策的同时获取共享弧段。

Result: 在原始论文合成数据集上，切角描述子在所有测试配置中表现不低于甚至优于图像窗口方法；流水线准确率达98%，而原方法修正评估后为93%–95%。仅用合成数据训练，在PairingNet基准上AUC为0.93；在PairingNet配对搜索协议下，真实集Recall@10为0.82，原论文最佳模型为0.56。

Conclusion: 基于切角剖面的局部描述与带状U-Net分割分类构成有效替代方案，兼具旋转与起点不变性，在合成与真实基准上均显著优于原图像窗口架构，并可同时输出共享弧段。

Abstract: This paper addresses the prediction of adjacency between pairs of 2D fragments based on their contours. We improved the two-stage architecture proposed in Beaulac's thesis, in which a rotation-equivariant Siamese convolutional neural network scores pairs of local image windows along the two contours of two fragments. The scores are gathered in an adjacency matrix in which a ResNet detects the partial anti-diagonal band that reveals the adjacency of two fragments. In the current work, we keep the pipeline and replace the local score by a comparison of tangent-angle profiles of contour windows, making it, by construction, invariant to fragment rotation and agnostic to the selected contour-starting point. These adaptations may be either a training-free likelihood ratio or a small one-dimensional convolutional model trained on corresponding points. We also replaced the final classifier by a band U-Net that segments the band and classifies the pair, so that the shared arc is obtained along with the decision. In the synthetic data set of the original thesis, the tangent descriptor performs as well as or better than the image-window approach in all tested configurations. The proposed pipeline reaches an accuracy of 98%, vs 93% to 95% for the original approach once its evaluation is corrected. We tested our pipeline, with models trained only on synthetic data, on the PairingNet benchmark, and obtained an AUC of 0.93. Furthermore, under the PairingNet pair-searching protocol conditions, our learned descriptor obtains a Recall@10 of 0.82 on the real set against 0.56 from the best model of the original paper.

</details>


### [61] [InstanceBench: Diagnosing Referential Reasoning and Target Identity in Referring Expression Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09478)
*Yuchen Li,Shaoyang Zhou,Yiran Wang,Ruiyi Deng,Haoyu Wang,Ziru Wei,Zhen Zhao,Luping Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出 InstanceBench，一个以实例为中心的诊断型基准，用于评估指代分割（RES）中的实例级指代推理，通过同目标变体表达、指代逻辑分类与身份感知指标，区分目标选择与掩码生成错误，并发现目标选择是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 RES 评估缺乏对实例级指代推理的系统洞察：无法区分指代逻辑、无法检验在多种有效定位路径下目标是否保持一致、也无法将目标选择错误与掩码生成错误分离。

Method: 构建 InstanceBench：包含 6,194 张图像、9,264 个目标实例、25,077 条人工核验表达。每个目标中心表达集（TCES）固定图像与目标掩码，将最小表达与使用另一有效线索或定位路径的同目标变体配对。设计紧凑的指代逻辑分类体系（直接目标证据、同类选择、关系与组合定位、排除），并通过逻辑关键构造抑制捷径。提出身份感知指标衡量目标保持与集合级成功率，并分离选择错误与掩码生成错误。

Result: 在来自 18 个模型家族的 22 个原生掩码 RES 检查点上评测：最强检查点达到 67.1% mIoU，但 All@0.7 仅 59.6%。受控干预验证了语言敏感性；失败分解表明主要瓶颈是目标选择而非掩码解码。在受控训练子集上，匹配监督可提升身份感知性能。

Conclusion: InstanceBench 支持“测量—诊断—改进”循环：测量跨定位路径的目标一致性、定位失败来源、评估针对性干预；诊断出的能力可通过定向监督得到改善。

Abstract: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) links natural-language descriptions to pixel-level object masks. Yet standard evaluation provides limited insight into instance-level referential reasoning: it does not systematically distinguish referential logics, test target preservation across valid grounding paths, or separate target-selection from mask-generation errors. We introduce InstanceBench, an instance-centered diagnostic benchmark comprising 6,194 images, 9,264 target instances, and 25,077 human-verified expressions. Each target-centric expression set (TCES) fixes the image and target mask while pairing a minimal expression with a same-target variant that uses another valid cue or grounding path. A compact referential-logic taxonomy spans direct target evidence, same-class selection, relational and compositional grounding, and exclusion, while logic-critical construction suppresses simpler shortcuts. Identity-aware metrics measure target retention and set-level success while separating selection from mask-generation errors. Across 22 native-mask RES checkpoints from 18 model families, the strongest checkpoint reaches 67.1% mIoU but only 59.6% All@0.7. Controlled interventions confirm language sensitivity, while failure decomposition identifies target selection rather than mask decoding as the main bottleneck. On a controlled training subset, matched supervision improves identity-aware performance, showing that the diagnosed capability responds to targeted supervision. Collectively, InstanceBench supports a measure-diagnose-improve cycle: measuring target consistency across grounding paths, localizing failure sources, and evaluating targeted interventions.

</details>


### [62] [Gaussian Material Fields for Volumetric Multi-Energy CT Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09492)
*Jian Lin,Jiancheng Fang,Hongming Shan,Shaoyu Wang,Yang Chen,Qiegen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出高斯材料场（Gaussian material fields），用共享各向异性3D高斯基元与独立非负材料系数表示多材料三维分布，结合可微光谱前向模型与材料感知自适应密度控制，从多能投影重建体素级材料分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多能CT体材料分解需要一种在统一空间域内组织多个三维材料场、同时保留成分差异与局部结构差异的表示。现有表示难以兼顾跨材料空间基元共享与材料特有重建需求：共享几何可提升紧凑性，但局部表示能力须随各材料的重建需要自适应调整。

Method: 1) 表示：多个材料分布共享一组各向异性3D高斯基元，各基元对每种材料使用独立非负系数，共享几何构成连续空间基，系数决定各材料场贡献。2) 重建：构建可微光谱前向模型，将高斯材料路径积分与标定基矩阵结合，实现空间几何与材料成分联合优化。3) 密度控制：材料感知自适应密度控制，在聚合前保留材料特有细化证据，调节局部表示容量，兼顾空间大范围成分与稀疏细节。

Result: 采用公开CT数据经传统方法构建的伪参考材料图生成合成多能投影进行实验。15个案例中，相比最强基线平均PSNR提升4.03 dB、SSIM提升4.96%、NRMSE降低33.45%。材料级对比与组件消融支持局部结构恢复的改善；运行时与内存测量显示良好的计算可扩展性。

Conclusion: 结果表明高斯材料场是一种显式、自适应的体多材料重建表示，能有效提升多能CT体材料分解的重建质量与计算效率。

Abstract: Volumetric material decomposition in multi-energy computed tomography requires a representation that organizes multiple three-dimensional material fields in a common spatial domain while retaining differences in composition and local structure. We observe that spatial primitives can be shared across materials without tying their coefficients, but their local capacity must respond to material-specific reconstruction needs. We introduce Gaussian material fields, which represent multiple material distributions with shared anisotropic 3D Gaussian primitives and independent nonnegative material coefficients. The shared geometry defines a continuous spatial basis, while the coefficients determine each primitive's contribution to the individual material fields. To reconstruct this representation from multi-energy projections, a differentiable spectral forward model combines Gaussian material path integrals with a calibrated basis matrix, enabling joint optimization of spatial geometry and material composition. Material-aware adaptive density control retains material-specific refinement evidence before aggregation and adjusts local representation capacity to accommodate both spatially extensive components and sparse details. Experiments use synthesized multi-energy projections generated from pseudo-reference material maps constructed by conventional methods from publicly available CT data. Across 15 cases, our approach improves average PSNR by 4.03 dB and SSIM by 4.96% over the strongest baseline, while reducing NRMSE by 33.45%. Material-wise comparisons and component ablations support improved recovery of localized structures, while runtime and memory measurements show favorable computational scaling. These results establish Gaussian material fields as an explicit, adaptive representation for volumetric multi-material reconstruction.

### [63] [SpatialUQ: Post-Hoc Uncertainty Quantification from Spatial Consistency in Black-Box Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09498)
*Md Kawsher Mahbub,Milon Biswas,Mirza Niaz Morshed,Wei Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SpatialUQ：仅用输出概率的后验不确定性方法，通过全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪均值间的Jensen-Shannon散度检测失效，在ChestX-ray14上以五分之一算力取得0.784失效检测AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床视觉模型常以冻结黑盒部署，推理时无法访问内部结构、无法重训练、也无真实标签，因此需要一种仅依赖输出概率的后验不确定性估计方法。

Method: SpatialUQ假设可信预测应具有空间一致性：在六次确定性前向中，计算全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪预测均值之间的Jensen-Shannon散度，得到Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS)；并将MUS与熵、置信度和ℓ1做有监督融合。

Result: 在NIH ChestX-ray14（DenseNet-121，N=25,596）上，MUS失效检测AUC为0.784，优于MC-Dropout的0.664（p<10^-6）且算力仅为其五分之一，原生校准SCE=0.049（ℓ1为0.127）。融合方法达0.832，超过五成员集成（0.813）。MUS随模型质量提升，BiomedCLIP上达0.899（ρ=0.846）；同分布下ρ=0.523，严重分布漂移(VinBigData)下ρ=0.027。

Conclusion: SpatialUQ是一种低成本、高校准的后验不确定性方法，适用于弥漫性病变，但对结节等小局灶性病变可靠性较低；其与模型质量的关系在分布漂移下失效。代码与实验材料已公开。

Abstract: Clinical vision models are often deployed as frozen black boxes with no access to internals, retraining, or ground truth at inference time. We introduce \textbf{SpatialUQ}, a post-hoc uncertainty method using only output probabilities. It measures the Jensen-Shannon divergence between the global prediction and the mean of five fixed spatial crops in six deterministic forward passes. The premise is simple, trustworthy predictions are spatially consistent. On NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, $N{=}25{,}596$), our Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS) reaches $0.784$ failure-detection AUC versus $0.664$ for MC-Dropout ($p{<}10^{-6}$) at one-fifth the compute, with native calibration ($\text{SCE}{=}0.049$ vs.\ $0.127$ for $\ell_1$), the best-calibrated among methods above 0.78 AUC. A supervised fusion of MUS with entropy, confidence, and $\ell_1$ reaches $0.832$, outperforming a five-member ensemble ($0.813$). MUS scales with model quality, reaching $0.899$ with BiomedCLIP ($ρ= 0.846$), while this relationship remains meaningful in-distribution ($ρ= 0.523$) but breaks down under severe distribution shift (VinBigData, $ρ= 0.027$). MUS is well-suited to diffuse findings but is less dependable for small focal lesions such as nodules. Code and experimental materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ.

</details>


### [64] [RT-DETR-World: Transferring Rich LLM Semantics to Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09502)
*Yupeng Zhang,Ziyi Zhao,Juntao Cheng,Sheng Wang,Ningnan Guo,Ruize Han,Liang Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出紧凑型 DETR 检测器 RT-DETR-World，通过训练时多层级描述监督与双路径对齐，在保持实时效率的同时提升开放词汇检测的零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实时开放词汇检测（OVD）方法主要关注词表覆盖与高效的区域/查询-文本匹配，在严格效率约束下，紧凑检测器难以吸收丰富的实例语义与场景上下文，导致零样本泛化受限。作者认为除词表扩展外，可复用已见数据中的视觉-语义线索（属性、动作、状态、上下文关系）来增强泛化。

Method: 提出 RT-DETR-World：紧凑 DETR 式检测器，训练时迁移描述语义，推理时仅保留轻量查询-文本匹配。构建 GroundingCapv2 数据集，含三级监督：类别名（标准 OVD）、对象描述（实例级语义）、图像描述（对象关系与场景上下文），描述仅作训练监督。提出双路径描述对齐（DDA）：部署一致的 MiniLM 路径提供查询-类别监督与对象描述对齐；仅训练使用的 LLM 教师特征在对象级监督匹配查询、在图像级监督全局视觉表示，教师特征预计算且训练后移除教师模块。另提出关系感知负样本松弛（RNR），利用教师语义相似度松弛相关负样本同时保留精确正样本。

Result: 实验表明方法具有有竞争力的零样本精度以及良好的精度-效率权衡。代码将开源。

Conclusion: 通过训练时多层级描述监督、双路径对齐与关系感知负样本松弛，紧凑实时检测器可有效吸收可复用的视觉-语义线索，在严格效率约束下实现更优的零样本开放词汇检测。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) recognizes categories unseen during training through textual category queries, yet achieving strong generalization with real-time efficiency remains challenging. Beyond vocabulary scaling, zero-shot generalization may benefit from reusable visual--semantic cues learned from seen data, including attributes, actions, states, and contextual relations. Existing real-time OVD methods primarily emphasize vocabulary coverage and efficient region/query--text matching; under strict efficiency constraints, compact detectors may struggle to absorb rich instance semantics and scene context. We propose RT-DETR-World, a compact DETR-style detector that transfers the rich semantics conveyed by descriptions during training while retaining lightweight query--text matching at inference. We construct GroundingCapv2 with three levels of supervision: category names for standard OVD, object descriptions conveying instance-level semantics, and image descriptions conveying object relations and scene context. These descriptions serve only as training-time semantic supervision. To help the compact detector absorb these semantics, we propose Dual-Path Description Alignment (DDA), combining a deployment-consistent MiniLM pathway with a training-only LLM teacher. MiniLM provides query--category supervision and object-description alignment, while offline teacher features supervise matched queries and global visual representations at the object and image levels, respectively. All teacher features are precomputed, and the teacher-side modules are removed after training. We further propose Relation-Aware Negative Relaxation (RNR), which uses teacher-derived semantic similarities to relax related negatives while preserving exact positives. Experiments demonstrate competitive zero-shot accuracy and a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off. The code will be released.

</details>


### [65] [TERRA: Learning Transportable Latent Actions through Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09509)
*Tianxingjian Ding,Mubarak Shah,Yu Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出TERRA框架，用紧凑的时间效应（净特征变化＋低阶窗口内动态）描述视觉转移并学习连续隐动作，再用Effect-Anchored Transport（EAT）在跨初始状态复用隐码时将其效果锚定到源状态观测到的效应上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐动作以视觉转移推断的动作式编码监督机器人策略，但其有效性取决于两个未决问题：编码从转移中保留了什么（端点差丢失运动过程，完整序列引入无关变化），以及换到不同初始状态后编码是否仍表示同一含义（重构式方法只观察到隐码及其来源状态，无法回答复用问题）。作者主张这两个问题可在同一效应空间中得到解答。

Method: TERRA用紧凑时间效应表征一次转移——净特征变化加上低阶窗口内动态分量，并从此效应学习连续隐变量；同一效应空间兼作复用参考。Effect-Anchored Transport（EAT）在其他初始状态下解码隐变量，并将产生的效应锚定到其源状态观测到的效应，使隐码由跨情境的行为而非仅由来源转移塑造。评估使用冻结线性读出器。

Result: 在冻结线性读出器下，TERRA的动作预测比UniVLA和LAPA式基线更准确，在视觉干扰下退化更慢；当接受方情境远离源状态时，被迁移的转移仍保持与供体动作一致。同预算对照显示增益主要来自EAT。在匹配预训练规模下，完整系统在LIBERO上达到93.4%平均成功率，UniVLA为91.8%。

Conclusion: 以紧凑时间效应为核心的表征与跨情境效应锚定机制，可同时刻画“保留什么”和“复用是否同义”两个问题，并在动作预测鲁棒性、迁移保真度和下游策略成功率上优于对比方法，其中EAT贡献主要增益。

Abstract: Latent actions supervise robot policies with action-like codes inferred from visual transitions, and their usefulness hinges on two questions: what a code keeps from a transition, and whether it still means the same thing when reused in a different initial state. The first is a tension in time: an endpoint difference discards how motion unfolds, while the full sequence admits nuisance variation. The second is left open by reconstruction, which only ever observes a latent together with the state it came from. We argue that both questions can be answered in the same place. TERRA (Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment) describes a transition by a compact temporal effect, its net feature change together with a low-order within-window dynamics component, and learns a continuous latent from this effect. The same effect space then serves as the reference for reuse: Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) decodes a latent in other initial states and anchors the resulting effect to the one observed at its source, so that the latent is shaped by what it does across contexts rather than only by the transition it came from. With frozen linear readers, TERRA predicts actions more accurately than UniVLA and a LAPA-style baseline, degrades more slowly under visual distractors, and keeps transported transitions faithful to the donor action as the recipient context moves farther away; a same-budget control shows that these gains come largely from EAT. At matched pretraining scale, the complete system reaches 93.4% average success on LIBERO, compared with 91.8% for UniVLA.

</details>


### [66] [LiG-DETR: Local-in-Global Reassembly in Latent Space for Aerial Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09511)
*Yupeng Zhang,Fangzhuo Gao,Juntao Cheng,Ziyi Zhao,Liang Wan,Ruize Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LiG-DETR，将图像切片重构为高保真局部特征获取，通过局部特征重组装与单一DETR解码器实现全局-局部统一端到端航空目标检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空目标检测存在显著的尺度与密度变化：小目标易在下采样和特征压缩中退化，中大型目标则需充分全局上下文。现有两类方法各有局限——图像切片提供清晰局部证据但依赖独立的裁剪级预测与后处理；特征/查询级优化保持统一推理，但仅作用于已压缩的全图表示，难以恢复细粒度信息。

Method: 提出LiG-DETR（高效全局-局部重组装框架）：共享编码器提取全局与局部放大特征并投影到检测器特征空间；按原始空间位置重组装局部特征，形成全局对齐的局部特征层级，由单一DETR解码器联合解码全局与局部特征。为减少冗余计算，引入上下文保留选择性重组装（Context-Preserved Selective Reassembly），对信息量高的区域进行高分辨率编码同时保持稠密特征布局；并设计密度感知自适应查询分配（Density-Aware Adaptive Query Allocation），利用编码器候选得分自适应调整解码器查询预算。

Result: 实验表明，方法在小目标和中型目标上取得显著增益，同时保持较强的大目标性能，具备良好的精度-效率权衡，并提升了跨域泛化能力。代码将开源。

Conclusion: 验证了在特征退化前直接获取高保真局部证据并整合进统一端到端框架的可行性，LiG-DETR通过全局-局部特征重组装与自适应查询分配，有效缓解航空目标的尺度与密度变化问题。

Abstract: Aerial object detection faces substantial scale and density variations. Small objects are easily degraded by downsampling and feature compression, while medium and large objects require sufficient global context. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: image slicing provides clearer local evidence but relies on independent crop-level prediction and post-processing, whereas feature- and query-level optimization preserves unified inference but operates on already compressed full-image representations, limiting recovery of fine-grained information. This raises a key question: can aerial detection directly acquire high-fidelity local evidence before feature degradation and integrate it into a unified end-to-end framework? To this end, we propose LiG-DETR, an Efficient Global-Local Reassembly framework that reformulates image slicing as high-fidelity local feature acquisition. A shared encoder extracts global and locally magnified features, which are projected into the detector feature space. The projected local features are reassembled according to their original spatial locations to form a globally aligned local feature level, and a single DETR decoder jointly decodes global and local features. To reduce redundant computation, Context-Preserved Selective Reassembly focuses high-resolution encoding on informative regions while preserving a dense feature layout, and Density-Aware Adaptive Query Allocation adapts the decoder query budget using encoder proposal scores. Experiments show substantial gains on small and medium objects while retaining strong large-object performance, with favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-offs and improved cross-domain generalization. The code will be released.

</details>


### [67] [OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09513)
*Zhenyang Liu,Chenjie Cao,Yisu Zhang,Xuhui Zuo,Xiangyang Xue,Yanwei Fu,Tengfei Wang,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OmniCam，一个从单张全景图和文本轨迹描述生成相机位姿序列的自回归模型，并构建OmniCaT数据集（267,700条轨迹），在轨迹误差和碰撞率上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机轨迹控制视频生成、场景重建和机器人感知中的视角变化，而从语言生成轨迹需要同时具备场景几何信息和目标感知的取景能力，现有方法在这两方面存在不足。

Method: OmniCam采用几何锚定的位姿token学习，包含三部分：(1)全景点云编码器提供全向几何上下文；(2)混合的绝对旋转与相对平移token化，配合时间一致的四元数符号；(3)分离的几何与语义条件流，并引入显式的3D目标锚点。同时构建OmniCaT数据集，涵盖四类相机行为的26.77万条轨迹。

Result: 在OmniCaT评测上，相比在OmniCaT上重训练的GenDoP，OmniCam轨迹误差降低28%–47%，碰撞率降低65.8%；相比各指标最优基线，ATE降低43.0%，碰撞降低62.3%。组件消融验证了几何条件与目标感知条件的有效性。

Conclusion: 几何锚定的位姿token学习与目标感知条件能有效提升语言到相机轨迹生成的质量，下游实验进一步验证了其在相机控制视频生成和机器人主动感知中的应用价值。

Abstract: Camera trajectories control viewpoint changes in video generation, scene reconstruction, and robotic perception. Generating them from language requires both scene geometry and target-aware framing. We introduce OmniCam, an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from a single panorama and textual trajectory descriptions. Its geometry-grounded pose token learning combines three components: a panoramic point-cloud encoder for omnidirectional geometric context; hybrid absolute-rotation and relative-translation tokenization with temporally consistent quaternion signs; and separate geometric and semantic conditioning streams with an explicit 3D target anchor. We also construct OmniCaT, containing 267,700 trajectories across four camera behaviors. On the reported OmniCaT evaluation, OmniCam reduces trajectory errors by 28--47% and collision rate by 65.8% relative to GenDoP retrained on OmniCaT. Against the best baseline for each metric, the ATE and collision reductions are 43.0% and 62.3%, respectively. Component ablations support the use of geometric and target-aware conditioning, while downstream experiments examine camera-controlled video generation and robotic active perception.

</details>


### [68] [STRIKE: Learning Visual State Transitions for Physical World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09514)
*Wenbin Teng,Tianshuo Xu,Depu Meng,Yuelei Li,Quentin Herau,Yihan Hu,Yajie Zhao,Wei Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STRIKE将视觉状态转移学习与密集视频生成解耦，以图像级转移模型作为中间表示进行物理世界建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理世界建模需要预测交互如何改变场景，而非仅生成连贯运动；现有视频生成方法难以保证物理一致性。

Method: 构建事件对齐监督：从训练视频提取观测状态，配对转移描述与时间偏移。图像级转移模型根据当前图像、局部转移说明和经过时间预测下一场景配置。推理时由预训练视觉-语言规划器预测时间转移说明，递归应用转移模型生成未来视觉状态序列；再以单独训练的动态模型，基于这些状态及其时间位置生成完整rollout。

Result: 在Physics-IQ Verified、PhyGenBench、Pisa-Experiments和RoboTwin2.0上，STRIKE在物理一致性与操作视频保真度指标上优于对应视频骨干基线。

Conclusion: 学习到的视觉状态转移可作为物理世界建模的有效中间表示。

Abstract: Physical world modeling requires predicting how interactions change a scene, not merely generating coherent motion. We propose STRIKE, a framework that separates visual state transition learning from dense video generation. We construct event-aligned supervision by extracting observed states from training videos and pairing them with transition descriptions and temporal offsets. An image-based transition model learns to predict the next scene configuration from the current image, a local transition specification, and elapsed time. At inference, a pretrained vision-language planner predicts time transition specifications, and recursive application of the learned transition model produces a sequence of future visual states. A separately trained dynamic model then generates the complete rollout conditioned on these states and their temporal locations. Experiments on Physics-IQ Verified, PhyGenBench, Pisa-Experiments, and RoboTwin2.0 show improvements of STRIKE over the corresponding video-backbone baselines in benchmark measures of physical consistency and manipulation-video fidelity. These results support learned visual state transitions as an effective intermediate representation for physical world modeling.

</details>


### [69] [It Is Not Seeing the Hazard: A Frozen Vision-Language Safety Score Measures Its Caption Bank](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09517)
*Samuel Tetteh,Cody Fleming*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文对冻结CLIP提示边际安全分数进行受控评估，发现在约20步前分数下降，但机制对照显示该分数主要追踪场景与caption的相似性，而非真正的危险感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冻结的视觉语言模型被越来越多地用作强化学习的安全信号，其假设是"与危险描述语言的相似性"等同于危险本身。然而，策略回报和碰撞率无法区分该分数是在检测危险，还是在响应场景中相关性特征（如提示结构、嵌入几何、相机视角），因此其安全含义尚未被验证。

Method: 作者对冻结CLIP的提示边际（prompt-margin）安全分数进行受控评估：将分数应用于从未接收该分数的策略所生成的轨迹；将接触前观测与具有可比危险几何的无接触观测进行匹配；并对caption、编码器和相机视角进行变量控制。

Result: 在三种策略、180个回合和130个孤立接触起点上，分数在接触前约20步开始下降。机制对照表明该分数主要追踪场景与其caption的共有相似性，并随caption间距和相机视角变化。恒定置信度对照仍保留了较低的灾难率点估计，说明策略收益并不能证明危险感知。

Conclusion: 基于VLM图像-文本相似度的安全信号并不必然反映真正的危险感知；策略性能提升可能来自提示结构、嵌入几何或视角等混杂因素，因此不能以策略收益作为危险感知的证据。

Abstract: Frozen vision-language models increasingly provide safety signals for reinforcement learning. Their use assumes that similarity to language describing danger indicates the hazard itself. Yet policy return and collision rate cannot reveal whether a score detects hazards or responds to correlated features of the scene. VLM-based methods have reported gains in driving and safe-RL benchmarks by converting image-text similarity into rewards, costs, or confidence weights. Such signals promise to reduce reliance on manually designed feedback. They may also reflect prompt structure, embedding geometry, or camera viewpoint, leaving their safety meaning unverified. To address this gap, we present a controlled evaluation of a frozen CLIP prompt-margin safety score. We apply the score to trajectories generated by policies that never receive it, match pre-contact observations to contact-free observations with comparable hazard geometry, and vary the captions, encoder, and camera view. Across three policies, 180 episodes, and 130 isolated contact onsets, the score decreases for about twenty steps before contact. Mechanism controls indicate that the score mainly tracks resemblance to the scene shared by its captions and changes with caption separation and camera view. A constant-confidence control retains the lower catastrophe-rate point estimate, so policy gains do not establish hazard perception.

</details>


### [70] [ActiveLang: Active Open-Vocabulary 3D Mapping with Semantic-Uncertainty-Guided Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09518)
*Liyan Chen,Hairong Yin,Huangying Zhan,Yi Xu,Raymond A. Yeh,Philippos Mordohai*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在多样化任务中需要同时具备几何与语义理解能力，且常在未知环境中执行新任务、无法预先获知相关概念。这要求构建带语言标注的 3D 地图以支持开放词汇场景理解与人机交互，而现有方法在观测效率、内存开销与在线适应能力上仍有不足。

Method: ActiveLang 是一个自主主动开放词汇 3D 建图系统，采用语义不确定性引导的探索策略。它在一个紧凑的双高斯（dual-Gaussian）表示上进行在线语言特征适配，联合重建场景几何、外观与开放词汇语义，且内存开销可控；其规划器高效选择信息量大的视角，从而以更少观测与更低计算成本完成有效建图。

Result: 在 Replica 和 ScanNet++ 数据集上，ActiveLang 在 2D 与 3D 开放词汇分割任务上相对在线与离线基线均有显著提升，表明主动探索场景能够更高效地构建带语言标注的 3D 地图。

Conclusion: 主动探索结合语义不确定性引导，可显著提升开放词汇 3D 建图的效率与质量，为机器人在未知环境中的语言驱动场景理解提供了可行方案。

Abstract: As robots increasingly assist humans with diverse tasks, they need both geometric and semantic understanding of their surroundings. Moreover, robots often operate in unfamiliar environments and take on new tasks without knowing the relevant concepts ahead of time. This motivates language-annotated 3D maps that support open-vocabulary scene understanding and human-robot interaction. We introduce ActiveLang, an autonomous system for active open-vocabulary 3D mapping with semantic-uncertainty-guided exploration. ActiveLang performs online language-feature adaptation on a compact dual-Gaussian representation to jointly reconstruct scene geometry, appearance, and open-vocabulary semantics with modest memory overhead. Its planner efficiently selects informative viewpoints, enabling effective mapping with fewer observations and lower computational cost. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ demonstrate substantial improvements in 2D and 3D open-vocabulary segmentation over both online and offline baselines, highlighting that actively exploring scenes builds language-annotated 3D maps more efficiently.

</details>


### [71] [KASALv2: Fully Automatic 3D Rotational Symmetry Classification and Axis Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09534)
*Mengxin Zhang,Yulin Wang,Chen Luo,Yongzhe Li,Yijun Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种全自动、无参考的3D物体旋转对称性分析框架，可对八类典型旋转对称进行分类、阶数识别与完整对称轴定位，并验证其提升6D位姿估计精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旋转对称性是6D位姿估计的重要先验，可提升位姿精度并支持对称性感知评测。然而现有3D物体对称性标注多依赖人工或半自动方式，通常需要预定义对称类型或阶数，难以规模化。

Method: 该框架首先定位主导的高阶旋转轴，通过自一致性分析推断其旋转阶数，并在层级引导的建模下重建完整对称结构；同时提出纹理感知扩展，在保持轴方向的前提下建模由外观引起的旋转阶数降低。全过程无参考、全自动。

Result: 在理想化与真实数据集上取得较高精度和泛化能力，在GSO的438个对称物体上达到94.75%准确率；将估计的旋转先验用于训练FoundationPose，在五个BOP数据集上精度最高提升0.9%。

Conclusion: 研究表明，自动估计的旋转对称先验可有效改善下游6D位姿估计，且该无参考框架具备良好的可扩展性与泛化性。代码已开源。

Abstract: Rotational symmetry is an important prior in 6D pose estimation, improving pose accuracy and supporting symmetry-aware evaluation. However, current symmetry annotations for 3D objects remain largely manual or semi-automatic, often requiring predefined types or orders, which limits scalability. This work introduces a fully automatic, reference-free framework for symmetry-type classification, rotational-order identification, and full-axis localization across all eight canonical 3D rotational symmetry types. The method localizes a dominant high-order axis, infers its rotational order through self-consistency analysis, and reconstructs the complete symmetry structure under a hierarchy-guided formulation. A texture-aware extension further models appearance-induced reductions in rotational order while preserving axis orientations. Experiments on idealized and real-world datasets demonstrate strong accuracy and generalization, achieving 94.75% accuracy on 438 symmetric objects in GSO. Training FoundationPose with these priors improves accuracy by up to 0.9% across five BOP datasets, showing that automatically estimated rotational priors improve downstream 6D pose estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/KASAL.

</details>


### [72] [WAPR: A Foundation Model for Wide-Angle Refinement in Unseen Object Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09535)

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Real-world applications require 6D pose estimation to be accurate, fast, and scalable to unseen objects. This paper introduces WAPR, a zero-shot wide-angle pose refinement model that refines candidate poses with rotational deviations up to 90 degrees. With as few as 12 candidate poses per detected object instance, WAPR supports fast inference within 1 s per frame and reaches a pose-estimation throughput of up to 25 detected object instances per second. To support wide-angle training for rotationally symmetric objects, WAPR uses rotational symmetry priors to canonicalize symmetry-equivalent pose targets before loss computation. We further construct SA6D, a large-scale 6D training dataset with such priors. SA6D obtains KASAL-assisted rotational symmetry priors for 944 GSO scans and expands them through geometry and texture augmentation into about 50K augmented object instances and about 2M rendered RGB-D images. In addition, an angle-balanced loss stabilizes learning across different angular ranges by reducing the influence of uninformative large-error cases. Experiments on seven BOP core datasets show that WAPR achieves state-of-the-art performance in unseen-object 6D pose localization and detection under both fast and unconstrained inference settings. Project page: https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR.

</details>


### [73] [Visual Evidence Under Cross-Examination: Evaluating and Controlling Decision-Level Evidence Use in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09550)
*Huiyao Zhang,Jin Bai,Zilong Su,Rui Guo,Chaofan Qin,Jinze Lv,Wenhui Yu,Hongfei Wang,Ye Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出候选绑定视觉贡献的研究视角与CROSS-Bench基准，并通过RIVET接口实现证据身份、不确定性与强度的分离控制，验证视觉证据的效用与其作用对象可以分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型的推理日益依赖裁剪、区域和工具产生的观察，但观察可能在不支持其对应候选答案的情况下仍影响最终答案。作者希望研究“候选绑定视觉贡献”，即有效证据应当帮助其支持的候选，使其支持关系失效应消除其附加效应，而有效重绑定应将效应转向新候选。

Method: 构建CROSS-Bench基准，包含28,000个决策问题，并在专门评估子集上设置匹配的失效与重绑定测试。提出RIVET接口，保持证据身份与不确定性，构建候选条件化响应，并单独控制该响应的强度。通过共享证据实验、匹配容量与训练条件对比，以及从原始输入预测证据的设置进行验证。

Result: 共享证据实验显示任务准确率与证据归属可以分离。在匹配容量与训练下，RIVET在干净证据具有正效应的场景中，将归一化效应转移从0.512提升至0.651；该优势在常见评估样本和重复决策层拟合中保持。使用从原始输入预测的证据时，RIVET在四个冻结骨干网络上平均提升CROSS-Bench准确率5.70个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果将视觉证据的效用与其效应所指向的候选特定去向区分开来，表明视觉证据是否有用与其帮助哪个候选是两个可分离的问题。

Abstract: Vision-language models increasingly reason through crops, regions, and tool-produced observations. Yet an observation can influence the answer without benefiting the candidate it supports. We study candidate-bound visual contribution: valid evidence should help, invalidating its supporting relation should remove its additional effect, and valid rebinding should redirect that effect to the newly supported candidate. We introduce CROSS-Bench, a benchmark of 28,000 decision problems, with matched invalidation and rebinding tests on a dedicated evaluation subset. Our RIVET interface preserves evidence identity and uncertainty, composes a candidate-conditioned response, and separately controls its strength. Shared-evidence experiments show that task accuracy and evidence ownership can diverge. Under matched capacity and training, RIVET increases normalized effect transfer from 0.512 to 0.651 where clean evidence has a positive effect. The advantage persists on common evaluation examples and across repeated decision-layer fits. With evidence predicted from raw inputs, RIVET improves CROSS-Bench accuracy by an average of 5.70 pp across four frozen backbones, relative to the same models without auxiliary evidence. These results separate the utility of visual evidence from the candidate-specific destination of its effect.

</details>

*Linda-Sophie Schneider,Simon Wittl,Gabriel Herl,Andreas Maier*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种连续轨迹优化方法，将每个X射线源位姿视为连续变量，在扫描仪运动流形上通过梯度上升联合优化所有位姿，从而改进稀疏视角锥束CT的采集设计。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定候选池的轨迹优化无法进行离网细化，且每更换一个采集流形都需要针对具体对象重新预计算。作者希望把衰减与扫描仪运动学约束直接纳入稀疏视角采集设计，使同一优化器能适配多种扫描仪参数化并可快速迁移。

Conclusion: 连续位姿优化可将衰减和扫描仪约束直接纳入稀疏视角采集设计，在多种参数化下通用，并可在数秒内完成规划，具备向受限扫描仪包络与机器人CT平台迁移的可行性。

Abstract: Trajectory optimisation for cone-beam computed tomography (CT) determines which information sparse-view scans acquire. Fixed candidate pools prevent off-grid refinement and require new object-specific precomputation for each acquisition manifold. We make every source pose an individual continuous variable and move all poses jointly by gradient ascent on the scanner's kinematic manifold. The objective combines soft-Tuy plane coverage, continuous View Covariance Loss, and an analytic attenuation-aware ray-bundle penalty. The same optimiser handles circular, limited C-arm, two-axis, and freesphere parametrisations. On a Defrise flange, continuous selection recovers laminar defects invisible to a circular orbit, matches discrete swap search on the free sphere at the sparser budget, and leads at the denser one, with the same objective evaluated in every arm. A moderate elevation band already recovers most of the free-sphere gain at the defects, so the same optimiser transfers to bounded scanner envelopes. Photon noise preserves the ordering on the flange and compresses it on a dense fuel nozzle. Sparseprescan planning benefits from matching prescan and planned acquisition manifolds. Selection takes seconds rather than minutes without an object-specific reconstruction basis. Prescan-planned poses were executed on a robot CT bench and reconstructed in a common frame, demonstrating feasibility but no consistent metric gain over uniform band sampling. Continuous pose optimisation incorporates attenuation and scanner constraints directly into sparse-view acquisition design.

</details>


### [75] [STORK: Spatio-Temporal Observation of uterine contRactions via neural networKs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09598)
*Melissa Schween,Tristan Gottwald,Jordina Aviles Verdera,Lisa Story,Mary Rutherford,Jana Hutter*

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胎儿MRI中的子宫收缩通常依靠人工识别并被丢弃，限制了对收缩动力学的研究。需要一种自动化方法，在缺乏帧级标注的情况下检测并利用子宫收缩信息，以实现更丰富的子宫行为表型分析。

Method: 将子宫收缩活动检测（UCAD）定义为弱监督学习问题，提出STORK多实例学习模型，仅用序列级粗标签在动态MRI序列上训练。模型将3D时空卷积沿时间超平面分解为并行分支，以较低计算成本捕获连贯的组织运动，避免完整4D卷积。每帧嵌入结合强度信息与Demons估计的位移场，通过线性均值池化头聚合，从而在无帧级监督下事后恢复帧级收缩评分。

Conclusion: STORK为子宫收缩检测提供了自动化工具，支持对子宫行为进行更丰富的表型分析，并验证了弱监督多实例学习在动态胎儿MRI分析中的有效性。

Abstract: Uterine contractions in fetal MRI are typically identified manually and discarded, limiting insights into contraction dynamics. We formalize Uterine Contractile Activity Detection (UCAD) as a weakly-supervised learning problem and introduce STORK, a multi-instance learning model trained on dynamic MRI series using only coarse, series-level labels. STORK factorizes 3D spatio-temporal convolutions into parallel branches across temporal hyperplanes to capture coherent tissue motion without the cost of full 4D convolutions. Per-frame embeddings, combining intensity and Demons-estimated displacement fields, are aggregated by a linear mean-pooling head. This ensures that frame-level contraction scores can be recovered post-hoc without frame-level training supervision. Evaluated on around 700 multi-vendor dynamic fetal MRI series, STORK achieves a series-level AUROC of 95.0% and AUPRC of 94.6%, substantially outperforming 3D ResNet and ConvNeXt baselines. Grad-CAM analysis suggests that the model draws on predictive features extending beyond the placenta into the uterine tissue, offering an automated tool for richer phenotyping of uterine behavior.

</details>

Landman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HAPPEN——一个人机协同（human-in-the-loop）流程，用SHA-256指纹做精确重复检测、用监督对比检索发现可能同源的近重复扫描，并在95000+扫描的聚合库中审计身份重复问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 国家级MRI数据仓库整合多研究、多机构数据后，仅在各数据集内部有效的被试标识可能不再全局唯一，导致同一被试被赋予多个ID（身份重复）。这会引发训练/测试数据泄漏并虚高下游生物医学研究的表观性能，而现有方法缺乏仓库规模的端到端、基于图像的审计流程。

Method: HAPPEN流程：结合SHA-256指纹实现精确重复检测，并采用监督对比学习检索可能来自同一人的非完全相同的扫描；检索出的配对作为候选，在本地部署的界面中由人工审核，而非自动判定为重复。在95,129张扫描的聚合仓库中部署，并用54对基因参考配对评估端到端召回；另在独立机构的22,386张扫描上本地部署同一流程（不重训模型、不传输图像）评估可迁移性，由外部团队自选操作阈值与审核标准。

Result: 在研究仓库中识别出1,316个精确重复扫描组和1,275个经审核者支持的近重复被试组；其中分别有56%和82%跨越数据集边界。全部54对基因参考配对均被召回；外部团队在本地完成全流程，独立选用阈值与审核标准。

Conclusion: HAPPEN提供了可迁移、人机协同的T1加权脑MRI仓库身份重复审计方案，能发现跨数据集的精确与近重复，避免自动误判，并在外部机构复现，有助于防止数据泄漏与性能虚高。

Abstract: National-scale magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) repositories increasingly integrate data from different studies and institutions. However, subject identifiers that are valid only within individual datasets are no longer guaranteed to remain globally unique after aggregation, making it possible for the same subject to be assigned multiple identifiers, which we define as identity duplication. Such duplication can create leakage between training and test data and inflate apparent performance in downstream biomedical studies. Existing methods do not provide an end-to-end, image-based workflow for auditing this problem at repository scale. In this work, we present HAPPEN, a human-in-the-loop pipeline for auditing identity duplication in T1-weighted brain MRI repositories. It combines SHA-256 fingerprinting for exact-duplicate detection with supervised contrastive retrieval of non-identical scans that may originate from the same person. Retrieved pairs are reviewed as candidates in a locally hosted interface rather than automatically classified as duplicates. We deployed the workflow in a 95,129-scan aggregated repository and assessed end-to-end recovery using 54 genetic-reference pairs. Transferability was assessed by locally deploying the same workflow on 22,386 scans at an independent institution without model retraining or image transfer. Deployment in the study repository identified 1,316 exact-duplicate scan groups and 1,275 reviewer-supported near-duplicate subject groups. Of these groups, 56% and 82%, respectively, crossed dataset boundaries. All 54 genetic-reference pairs were recovered. The external team independently completed the full workflow using a locally selected operating threshold and review standard.

</details>


### [77] [Quasi-Binarized Autoencoders: An Architecture-Independent Information Bottleneck for Medical Image Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09670)
*Shouhei Hanaoka,Takahiro Nakao,Atsushi Takamatsu,Takeharu Yoshikawa,Osamu Abe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出准二值化（QB）层，通过对潜变量施加[0,1]压缩与拉普拉斯噪声约束重建与输入的互信息，构建QBAE模型在医学图像无监督异常检测中取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于重建的无监督医学图像异常检测依赖"信息瓶颈"来防止网络学到恒等映射（否则会连异常一起重建）。但传统瓶颈通过架构选择实现，需按数据集调参，且无法用比特量化其容量。

Method: 设计QB层：将每个潜变量压缩到[0,1]并加入尺度为1/ε的拉普拉斯噪声，使每个元素满足ε-局部差分隐私；由此图像与重建之间的互信息上界仅取决于ε和QB元素数量，与编解码器无关。将所有编解码路径（含跳跃连接）都加QB层，构建QBAE——含32768个QB元素的七层注意力U-Net。

Result: 在MedIAnomaly基准的七个数据集上，单一架构与配置的QBAE达到平均图像级AUROC 0.828，为不针对各数据集自适应方法中最高；在BraTS2021上取得最佳已报告结果（AUROC 0.911，像素级AP 0.838）。测试时保留噪声；无输入破坏时，仅靠瓶颈即可防止恒等坍缩（平均AUROC 0.805 vs 0.590）。

Conclusion: QB层提供了可量化、架构无关的信息瓶颈，将差分隐私与互信息约束引入重建式异常检测，QBAE以单配置在多数据集上实现领先性能。

Abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection, which learns only from normal images, is a central task in medical image analysis and remains an open problem. Reconstruction-based methods pass an image through an encoder-decoder network trained on normal data and detect anomalies from the residual between the image and its reconstruction. This works only if the information passed from the encoder to the decoder is limited; otherwise the network learns an identity mapping and reconstructs anomalies too. This limit is usually imposed through architectural choices, tuned per dataset, that cannot be stated in bits. We introduce the quasi-binarizing (QB) layer, which squashes each latent element into [0, 1] and adds Laplace noise of scale 1/epsilon. Each element is then epsilon-locally differentially private, and the mutual information between an image and its reconstruction is bounded by a quantity that depends only on epsilon and the number of QB elements, whatever the encoder and decoder. Placing a QB layer on every encoder-decoder path, including all skip connections, we build QBAE, a seven-level attention U-Net with 32,768 QB elements. On the seven datasets of the MedIAnomaly benchmark, QBAE with one architecture and one configuration reaches a mean image-level AUROC of 0.828, the highest among methods that do not adapt to each dataset, and the best reported results on BraTS2021 (AUROC 0.911, pixel-level AP 0.838). The noise is kept at test time, so that every reconstruction satisfies the bound. Without input corruption, the bottleneck alone prevents identity collapse (mean AUROC 0.805 vs. 0.590). Code is available at https://github.com/hanaokalog/MedIAnomalyQB.

</details>


### [78] [A Multi-Source Ultrasound Benchmark Revealing the Limits of Contemporary Self-Supervised Anomaly Detection Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09677)
*Marco Riedenauer,Daniel Kienzle,Pratik Mayekar,Rainer Lienhart*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SADUSI——一个跨解剖部位、视图与采集协议的多源超声异常检测基准，用于训练与评估自监督异常检测方法，并发现现有方法在多源场景下泛化能力不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督异常检测在医学超声中前景广阔，因为正常图像比覆盖所有可能病变的详尽标注更易获取。然而现有评估多局限于单一解剖部位或单一任务，无法判断模型学到的是稳健的"正常超声"表征，还是仅针对特定数据源的表示。因此需要一个涵盖广泛解剖区域、视图与采集协议的多源基准，以检验模型的泛化性。

Method: 作者构建了SADUSI多源超声数据集与基准，旨在提供多样化的正常超声分布，并针对单张图像即可判别的可见结构性异常进行评估。在此基准上，他们评测了代表性的自监督异常检测方法，包括基于重建的扩散模型（AnoDDPM、DeCo-Diff）以及基于特征的PatchCore变体。

Result: 基于重建的扩散方法表现较差，像素级AUROC仅为0.56–0.72，最大F1仅0.10–0.26，说明其难以区分病变区域与正常区域。基于特征的PatchCore变体表现更好，像素级AUROC达0.76–0.83，但最大F1仍仅0.14–0.40，分割/定位能力依然受限。

Conclusion: 广泛的多源超声异常检测仍是一个开放挑战；SADUSI可作为资源，推动发展能够超越解剖特异性设定、具备良好泛化能力的异常检测方法。

Abstract: Self-supervised anomaly detection is a promising paradigm for medical ultrasound, as normal images are often easier to obtain than exhaustive annotations of all possible pathologies. However, most existing evaluations are limited to a single anatomy or task, making it unclear whether models learn a robust notion of normal ultrasound appearance or only a source-specific representation. We introduce the SADUSI benchmark, a multi-source ultrasound dataset designed to train and evaluate anomaly detection methods across a broad range of anatomical regions, views, and acquisition protocols. The goal of SADUSI is to provide a diverse normal ultrasound distribution and a benchmark for visible structural anomalies that can be assessed from single images. We evaluate representative self-supervised anomaly detection methods and find that current approaches struggle in this setting. In particular, reconstruction-based diffusion methods such as AnoDDPM and DeCo-Diff achieve pixel-level AUROC values of 0.56-0.72 and maximum F1 scores of 0.10-0.26, indicating limited separation of pathology from normal image regions. Feature-based PatchCore variants perform better, reaching pixel-level AUROC values of 0.76-0.83, but remain limited with maximum F1 scores of 0.14-0.40. These findings suggest that broad multi-source ultrasound anomaly detection remains an open challenge and that SADUSI can serve as a resource for developing methods that generalize beyond anatomy-specific settings.

</details>


### [79] [What Makes Synthetic Hard Negatives Work in Vision-Language Pretraining?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09700)
*Nikos Giakoumoglou,Paschalis Giakoumoglou,Andreas Floros,Kleanthis Marios Papadopoulos,Tania Stathaki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文分析合成难负样本从单模态自监督学习迁移到视觉-语言预训练时的失败模式，并提出 SNAP 方法加以规避。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在表示空间中生成合成难负样本对单模态自监督学习有效，但直接迁移到视觉-语言预训练并不顺利，因此需要分析迁移失败的原因。

Method: 分析六种表示空间合成策略，识别出两类失败模式：（1）跨模态构造产生过易负样本或将其拉向查询；（2）模态内构造会包含匹配的正样本。同时观察到使用合成难负样本与可学习温度时出现 logit 尺度饱和，固定温度可提升下游性能。据此提出 SNAP，生成从不涉及任一模态正样本的模态内难负样本。

Result: SNAP 与模型无关，无需外部生成模型，训练时间开销低于 10%。在 CLIP 与 FLIP 之上、跨多种架构与数据集评估，在零样本检索、零样本分类和线性探针评估上均取得一致提升。

Conclusion: 通过几何分析可揭示合成难负样本迁移到视觉-语言预训练的失败模式，SNAP 能完全规避这两类问题并带来稳定的下游性能提升。

Abstract: Synthetic hard negatives generated in the representation space have proven effective for unimodal self-supervised learning, but transferring this idea to vision-language pretraining is not straightforward. We analyze six representation-space synthesis strategies and identify two failure modes in their transfer to vision-language pretraining: cross-modal constructions that produce overly easy negatives or pull them toward the query, and intra-modal constructions that incorporate the matched positive. We also observe logit-scale saturation when training with synthetic hard negatives and a learnable temperature, and find that fixing the temperature improves downstream performance. Using this geometric analysis we propose SNAP, which generates intra-modal hard negatives that never involve the positive from either modality, avoiding both failure modes entirely. SNAP is model-agnostic, requires no external generative models, and adds less than 10% training time overhead. Evaluated on top of CLIP and FLIP across multiple architectures and datasets, SNAP delivers consistent improvements on zero-shot retrieval, zero-shot classification, and linear probe evaluation.

</details>


### [80] [Latent Watermarks under Generative Editing: A Benchmark and Analysis of Detection Survival](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09702)
*Sung Ju Lee,Nam Ik Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了基于提示的图像编辑对八种水印方法检测能力的影响，提出以干净分数分离度（d'）作为经验诊断指标，揭示聚合TPR所掩盖的检测差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 普通基于提示的编辑会在非针对性情况下导致潜在水印检测失效，已有评估多依赖聚合指标（如TPR），掩盖了检测能力下降的细节与机制差异，缺乏对编辑自身与后续失真作用的分解分析。

Method: 构建基准：8种水印方法 × 5种编辑器 × 4种生成骨干 × 4种编辑强度 × 5类语义类别，并加入编辑有效性与阈值检查。将编辑与后续7种失真分离评估，进行顺序编辑实验、嵌入强度干预实验，以及阈值重校准与复合权重替换的稳健性检验；用标准化干净分数分离度d'与空间重叠度进行关联分析。

Result: 仅编辑操作主要能区分Tree-Ring方法，加入失真后才暴露出更广的检测存活谱系；顺序编辑显示分数分离度下降时检测率仍可接近上限。干净d'能组织复合存活层级，而空间重叠度在干净可检测性之外对预测仅编辑存活贡献甚微。嵌入强度干预表明更高干净分离度对应更高编辑后分离度。HSTR中边缘对比为正，而匹配干净分离度下的角度布局对比仍未解决。方法分层在主操作点的阈值重校准与替代复合权重下保持稳定。

Conclusion: 在该基准内，干净d'是有用的经验诊断指标，但对未见方法的迁移效果混合。结果表明结果分解与连续分离度可揭示聚合TPR隐藏的方法差异，代码与支持材料计划另行发布。

Abstract: Ordinary prompt-based editing can cause latent watermark detection to fail without explicitly targeting the watermark. We benchmark eight watermark methods against five editors across four generative backbones, four editing strengths, and five semantic categories, with edit-validity and threshold checks.
