N-GNAS also introduces a contrastive learning loss to separate sample features from different categories and vice versa. In experiments conducted on eight datasets for node and graph classification, our methodology outperforms current leading GNAS techniques and traditional human-designed GNNs. For example, it achieves an accuracy rate of 78.26\% on the CiteSeer dataset.

</details>


### [287] [Kuration SDK: Addressing the Virtual2Real Gap via Data Curation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09305)
*Nirmit Desai,Eric Song,Mayank Sengupta,Tejal Bedmutha,Siri Reddy,Sahiti Dharmavaram,Kunal Sawarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出动作条件世界模型的现有基准存在"Virtual2Real gap"：视觉相似度指标（FVD、LPIPS、JEDi）无法反映实际可玩性。作者主张在训练前通过对原始游戏数据的策展（curation）与诊断属性测量来提供更可靠的信号，并开源了物理AI数据策展工具包Kuration SDK。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作条件世界模型的评测基准正从视觉相似度转向动作语义与物理接地指标，但对于域与任务无关的训练，现有基准提供的信号仍然有限。作者观察到定性可玩性与FVD、LPIPS、JEDi等指标不一致，即Virtual2Real gap，因此需要更稳健的数据侧信号来弥合该鸿沟。

Method: 在CounterStrike游戏数据上训练并评估扩散世界模型，对比定性可玩性与FVD、LPIPS、JEDi等指标；提出多种数据策展策略，并开发通用物理AI数据策展工具包Kuration SDK（随论文开源）。

Result: 证实定性可玩性与FVD、LPIPS、JEDi等指标不对应；Kuration SDK成功定位了一个具体案例中Virtual2Real gap的根因——两个在相同地图、动作与状态分布上训练、LPIPS与FVD得分相近的世界模型，在实际游玩时表现差异显著。

Conclusion: 在缺乏可靠基准的情况下，策展原始游戏数据并测量多种诊断属性，可在训练开始前提供更稳健的信号。Kuration SDK有望揭示特定数据集中Virtual2Real gap的根因，并加速高样本效率训练数据集的开发。

Abstract: Benchmarks for measuring the quality of action-conditioned world models are still evolving and shifting away from visual similarity-based metrics to action-semantic and physically-grounded metrics. However, for domain and task-agnostic action-conditioned world model training, existing benchmarks provide a limited signal. By training and evaluating diffusion world models on CounterStrike gameplay data, we confirm that qualitative playability does not correspond with metrics such as FVD, LPIPS, and JEDi. We term this the Virtual2Real gap. We posit that, in lieu of reliable benchmarks, curating raw gameplay data and measuring a variety of diagnostic properties provides a more robust signal to bridge the gap, before the training even begins. We present several curation strategies and a general-purpose kit for physical AI data curation called Kuration SDK, which is being open-sourced with this paper. The SDK was instrumental in uncovering the root cause of the virtual2real gap in a specific case: why two world models trained on identical gameplay map, action and state distribution, behaved very differently when played in spite of having very similar LPIPS and FVD scores. Thus, Kuration SDK has the potential to uncover the root causes of Virtual2Real gap in specific datasets and accelerate development of sample-efficient training datasets.

</details>


### [288] [MovieSTAGE: Scene, Transition, and Global Encoding for Movie-fMRI ADHD Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09306)
*Boseong Kim,Haejun Chung,Ikbeom Jang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MovieSTAGE多尺度框架，将电影fMRI中的场景内超图功能连接、相邻场景间无向功能连接差异与整部电影功能连接结合，用于精神疾病分类，在CMI-HBN队列上取得优于对照方法的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然主义电影fMRI可提供共享且具时间结构的大脑动态探针，但现有预测模型多依赖整段run的功能连接或与叙事事件不对齐的时间泛化表征，未能利用事件对齐的场景与转换信息，可能损失预测价值。

Method: 提出MovieSTAGE多尺度框架，包含三部分：场景内超图结构化的功能连接画像组织、相邻场景间的无向功能连接画像差异、以及整部电影的FC。基于CMI-HBN Despicable Me队列的260名被试，在病例对照、ADHD亚型和三分类任务上评估，采用10次重复分层五折交叉验证、完整折外预测，以及配对被试聚类bootstrap与置换检验；并比较超图神经网络（HGNN）场景编码器与MLP、GAT、BNT，以及人工标注分区与时长匹配随机、固定计数GSBS对照。

Result: MovieSTAGE在三项任务上的AUROC分别为0.69、0.73、0.75，平衡准确率分别为67.6%、69.8%、58.3%，在所有评估方法中平均点估计最高。三分类任务中完整模型优于所有两分支变体；HGNN场景编码器在匹配设置下优于MLP、GAT、BNT；人工标注分区优于时长匹配随机与固定计数GSBS对照。

Conclusion: 受控结果表明，在该队列中，事件对齐的场景与转换表征与整部电影FC结合后可提供增量预测价值；事后基于模型的分析进一步生成了涉及额顶网络与默认模式网络的网络层面假设。

Abstract: Naturalistic movie-fMRI provides a shared, temporally structured probe of brain dynamics, yet predictive models commonly rely on whole-run functional connectivity (FC) or temporally generic representations that are not aligned with narrative events. We introduce MovieSTAGE (Scene, Transition, and Global Encoding), a multiscale framework that combines hypergraph-structured FC-profile organization within scenes, unsigned FC-profile differences across adjacent scenes, and whole-movie FC. We evaluated 260 participants from the CMI-HBN Despicable Me cohort on case-control, ADHD-subtype, and three-class classification using 10 repetitions of stratified five-fold cross-validation, complete out-of-fold (OOF) predictions, and paired subject-cluster bootstrap and permutation tests. MovieSTAGE achieved AUROCs of 0.69, 0.73, and 0.75 and balanced accuracies of 67.6%, 69.8%, and 58.3%, respectively, yielding the highest mean point estimates among the evaluated methods. On the three-class task, the full model outperformed all two-branch variants, the HGNN scene encoder outperformed MLP, GAT, and BNT alternatives under matched settings, and the human-annotated partition outperformed duration-matched random and fixed-count GSBS controls. These controlled results support incremental predictive value from event-aligned scene and transition representations when combined with whole-movie FC in this cohort. Post-hoc model-derived analyses generated network-level hypotheses involving frontoparietal and default-mode systems.

</details>


### [289] [Denoising Blocks, Not Tokens: Efficient Compressed Continuous Diffusion with Branching Token Realization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09311)
*Xinsong Feng,Peng Du,Zhizhuo Yang,Daniel M. Bikel,Jiayun Wang,Haipeng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BLD提出将扩散语言模型的状态从token级压缩到块级潜在序列，用分支并行AR解码实现高效长序列生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散语言模型通常每个token维护一个生成状态，导致每一步去噪都要处理与输出等长的状态序列，限制了并行生成的吞吐收益。连续扩散语言模型允许单个连续状态表示多个token，为在更短潜在序列上做扩散提供自由度。

Method: BLD（Branching Latent Diffusion）将1024 token序列压缩为64个block latent，压缩率达16倍；结合潜在压缩与分支式token实现，每个latent由局部AR分支解码，所有分支并行运行；由于强压缩下联合latent生成困难，BLD按组生成latent，并以前面已生成的latent为条件。

Result: 在同GPU端到端评测中，相比同等规模ELFL基线，BLD生成FLOPs降低超过80倍，吞吐提升超过6倍；相比AR基线，吞吐提升超过6倍，延迟降低超过4倍；尽管有压缩，BLD保持有竞争力的局部流畅性和多样性，但长程连贯性仍有挑战。

Conclusion: 将扩散从token级状态转移到压缩的潜在序列，可显著提升长序列生成效率，说明潜在序列上的扩散是提升扩散语言模型效率的有效方向。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative parallel refinement, offering the potential for higher throughput than autoregressive (AR) decoding. However, most DLMs still maintain one generative state per token, so every denoising step processes a state sequence as long as the output sequence, limiting the throughput gains from parallel generation. Continuous DLMs provide an additional degree of freedom: a single continuous state can represent multiple tokens, allowing diffusion to operate on a much shorter latent sequence. We introduce \emph{Branching Latent Diffusion (BLD)}, which exploits this flexibility by compressing a 1024-token sequence into only 64 block latents, a $16\times$ reduction. BLD combines latent compression with \emph{branching token realization}, where each latent is decoded by a local AR branch and all branches run in parallel. Because strong compression makes joint latent generation difficult, BLD generates the latents in groups, conditioning each group on previously generated latents. In end-to-end evaluation on the same GPU, BLD reduces generation FLOPs by more than $80\times$ and increases throughput by more than $6\times$ relative to the similarly sized ELF-L baseline. Compared with the AR baseline, BLD achieves more than $6\times$ higher throughput and more than $4\times$ lower latency. Despite the compression, BLD maintains competitive local fluency and diversity, although long-range coherence remains challenging. Overall, BLD shows that moving diffusion from token-level states to compressed latent sequences can substantially improve the efficiency of long-sequence generation.

</details>


### [290] [Benign Overfitting under Heterogeneous Input Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09340)
*Houzhen Liu,Xiaobo Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究异构高斯设计下最小范数线性插值的良性过拟合问题，比较两个统计相关输入块及其融合，揭示融合后的良性/非良性由联合信号与谱几何决定，而非边际良性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 良性过拟合多在单一高维输入下被研究，异构输入融合下的行为尚不清楚，因此本文探究输入块融合对良性过拟合的影响。

Method: 在异构高斯设计下研究最小范数线性插值，固定总体任务，比较两个统计相关的输入块及其融合；回归中引入全谱协方差证书，分类中分析一稀疏高斯分类下的信号与干扰平衡。

Result: 回归中识别出全谱协方差证书，其渐近状态不依赖截断阈值，并被所有与两个边际一致的正半定联合协方差保持；该保护是尖锐的，但不推广到所有良性回归问题，认证区外两个良性边际可产生有害融合。分类中良性由幸存预测信号与干扰污染的平衡刻画，融合可使二者反向变化，且该模型类中任何边际到联合的良性/非良性模式都可实现；同一融合输入对回归与分类可产生定性不同影响。

Conclusion: 异构融合下的良性过拟合由输入交互产生的联合信号与谱几何决定，而非仅由边际良性决定。

Abstract: Benign overfitting is extensively studied when learning from a single high-dimensional input, but its behavior under heterogeneous input fusion remains largely unexplored. We study this question for minimum-norm linear interpolation under a heterogeneous Gaussian design, comparing two statistically dependent input blocks with their fusion while holding the underlying population task fixed. For regression, we identify a full-spectrum covariance certificate whose asymptotic status is independent of the cutoff threshold and prove that it is preserved by every positive-semidefinite joint covariance consistent with the two marginals. This protection is sharp, yet it does not extend to all benign regression problems: outside the certified regime, two benign marginals can have a harmful fusion. For one-sparse Gaussian classification, benignity in the regular regime is characterized by the balance between surviving predictive signal and nuisance contamination. Fusion can move these two quantities in opposite directions, and within this model class every marginal-to-joint benign/non-benign pattern is attainable. We further show that the same fused input can have qualitatively different effects on regression and classification. These results establish that benign overfitting under heterogeneous fusion is determined by the joint signal and spectral geometry created by input interaction, rather than by marginal benignity alone.

</details>


### [291] [Shared Low-rank Basis Factorization for Data-free Mixture-of-Experts Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09342)
*Tianxiao Cao,Jiahe Shao,Yuning Qiu,Kyohei Atarashi,Hisashi Kashima,Qibin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文分析三类MoE压缩方法（专家剪枝、专家合并、权重重建），从理论上证明剪枝和合并会因路由与专家异质性产生不可消除的结构性误差，而权重重建可避免此类误差。据此提出无需数据的共享低秩基分解方法SLBF，通过专家间共享秩-k基实现更强的跨专家共享、更快收敛和更低重建误差，并用后置规范固定去除冗余参数。在16B至122B参数的五个MoE架构上，SLBF一致优于三类压缩方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE大语言模型通过稀疏路由将容量与计算解耦，但庞大的参数量带来存储与服务挑战，因此需要有效的MoE压缩方法。然而现有压缩方法缺乏对结构误差来源的理论理解，难以判断哪类方法在本质上更优。

Method: 1) 对专家剪枝、专家合并、权重重建三类压缩族进行理论分析，推导结构性误差界，指出剪枝与合并的误差与路由及专家异质性相关且不会消失；2) 提出SLBF，一种无需数据的权重重建方法，使用在专家间共享的秩-k基，实现更丰富的跨专家共享；3) 通过后置规范固定（gauge fixing）在不损失表示能力的前提下移除冗余参数。

Result: 在参数量从16B到122B的五个MoE架构上，SLBF一致优于专家剪枝、专家合并和权重重建三类压缩方法。

Conclusion: 权重重建类方法在原理上优于剪枝与合并，因其保留专家结构和路由从而避免结构性误差；SLBF作为无需数据的共享低秩基分解方法，实现了更快的收敛与更低的重建误差，并在多种大规模MoE模型上取得稳定优异的压缩表现。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models decouple capacity from compute through sparse routing, but their large parameter count creates storage and serving challenges. We analyze three MoE compression families: expert pruning, expert merging, and weight reconstruction, and derive structural error bounds showing that pruning and merging can incur non-vanishing errors tied to routing and expert heterogeneity. In contrast, weight reconstruction avoids these structural costs by preserving expert structure and routing. Motivated by the analysis, we propose Shared Low-rank Basis Factorization (SLBF), a data-free weight reconstruction method that uses rank-$k$ bases shared among experts, enabling richer cross-expert sharing, faster convergence, and lower reconstruction error. A post-hoc gauge fixing removes redundant parameters at no representational cost. Across five MoE architectures spanning 16B to 122B parameters, SLBF consistently outperforms methods from all three compression families.

</details>


### [292] [Multimodal LLMs Can Learn to Read Brain Signals: A Vision--Language Model for Unified Multi-Task EEG Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09355)
*Parastoo Azizeddin,Omid Sharafi,Maryam M. Shanechi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 BraVista，一种将多通道 EEG 信号编码为结构化图像、并借助指令条件化视觉-语言模型实现多任务解码的框架，无需大规模 EEG 专用预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG 表征在跨认知任务、跨被试、跨记录条件下的泛化仍是难点；基础模型虽提升了解码性能，但如何有效将神经信号与通用基础模型对接以实现跨数据集多任务学习尚待解决。

Method: 将多通道 EEG 编码为结构化图像，利用指令条件化的视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行多任务学习；对通用域 VLM 进行持续后训练，借助其视觉与语言先验适配神经信号，不设独立的大规模 EEG 预训练阶段。

Result: 在睡眠分期、情绪识别、认知负荷分类与异常 EEG 检测四个数据集上均取得良好性能；分析表明 EEG 到图像的表示方式对性能至关重要；在受控噪声扰动下性能随噪声增强而渐进下降，说明模型依赖 EEG 相关信息而非表层视觉模式。

Conclusion: 结构化视觉表征可作为神经信号与通用域基础模型之间有效且可扩展的接口，支撑统一的多任务 EEG 解码。

Abstract: Learning EEG representations that generalize across cognitive tasks, subjects, and recording conditions remains a key challenge in electroencephalography (EEG) decoding. Recent advances in foundation models have improved EEG decoding performance, yet a fundamental open question remains: how to effectively interface neural signals with these models to enable multi-task learning across datasets. To investigate this question, we introduce BraVista, a visual-language framework that encodes multichannel EEG signals as structured images and enables multi-task learning through instruction-conditioned vision-language models (VLMs). Our approach relies on continued post-training of a general-domain VLM, leveraging its visual and linguistic priors to adapt to neural signals without a separate large-scale EEG-specific pretraining stage. We evaluate BraVista on four datasets spanning sleep staging, emotion recognition, cognitive workload classification, and abnormal EEG detection, showing strong performance across these tasks. Further analyses show that the choice of EEG-to-image representation is critical to performance. Moreover, through controlled perturbations of the EEG signal, we observe a gradual performance degradation under increasing noise, suggesting that the model relies on EEG-relevant information rather than superficial visual patterns. Together, these findings establish structured visual representations as an effective and scalable interface between neural signals and general-domain foundation models for unified multi-task EEG decoding.

</details>


### [293] [Global Exponential Convergence of Two-Layer Linear Network Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09356)
*Stephen Y Zhang,Gabriel Peyré*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明宽两层线性网络在光滑Polyak-Łojasiewicz预测损失下，梯度流以显式速率全局指数（线性）收敛，并通过有限维Bures流描述因子动态，给出均值场守恒律、有限宽度采样稳定性及深线性ResNet与重球动量的推广。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解宽双层线性网络在PL型损失下训练时为何及以何速率实现全局线性收敛，并刻画其动力学结构；同时希望将结论推广到深层及带动量情形，并保证有限宽度下的稳定性。

Method: 将因子空间上的梯度流精确闭合为神经元法则协方差的有限维Bures流，预测器动态被隐藏协方差块预条件；利用均值场守恒律在初始协方差满足谱支撑间隙条件时给出隐藏预条件块的一致谱下界；对Σ₀=σ²Id推导线性收敛速率4σ²κ；分析有限宽度采样稳定性与因子梯度下降的显式步长区间；将论证逐层推广到深线性ResNet（受残差路径界约束）；对重球动量，用提升的相位协方差在位置-速度上闭合动力学。

Result: 对Σ₀=σ²Id，损失以至少4σ²κ的线性速率收敛到全局最小值，κ为PL常数；该速率在有限宽度采样下稳定；给出依赖光滑度、初始损失与守恒谱边界的显式步长区间以保证因子梯度下降全局收敛；深线性ResNet在残差路径界下逐层成立；重球动量下线性收敛在能量与阻尼的显式条件下成立，给出可容许阻尼窗口，且双尺度白色初始化在位置尺度足够大时该区间非空；数值实验验证协方差几何并比较预测与观测速率。

Conclusion: 本文建立了宽双层线性网络在PL型预测损失下全局线性收敛的显式速率理论，核心是Bures流闭合与均值场守恒律提供的谱下界，并扩展到深线性ResNet和重球动量；结果揭示了协方差几何驱动的训练动力学，且速率在有限宽度与离散化下稳健。

Abstract: We prove global exponential (linear) convergence with an explicit rate in the rich scaling for wide two-layer linear networks trained with smooth Polyak-Lojasiewicz predictor losses. Gradient flow in the factors closes exactly in terms of a finite-dimensional Bures flow of the neuron law covariance, in which the predictor dynamics are preconditioned by hidden covariance blocks. Mean-field conservation laws provide uniform spectral lower bounds on the hidden preconditioning blocks when the initial covariance satisfies a spectral support gap condition. This condition encompasses positive definiteness while still allowing for singular initializations. For an initial covariance $Σ_0 = σ^2 \mathrm{Id}$, the loss converges to the global minimum with linear rate at least $4σ^2κ$, where $κ$ is the PL constant. We establish stability of this rate under finite-width sampling, as well as global convergence of factor gradient descent for an explicit stepsize interval depending on smoothness, the initial loss, and conserved spectral margins. Our argument extends layerwise to deep linear ResNets, subject to a residual-path bound. In the case of heavy-ball momentum, training dynamics close instead over positions and velocities in terms of a lifted phase covariance. Linear convergence holds under an explicit condition on the energy and damping, specifying a window of admissible dampings. For two-scale white initializations, this interval is nonempty for sufficiently large position scales, with a fixed initial loss gap and velocity covariance. Numerical experiments illustrate the covariance geometry and compare the predicted and observed rates.

</details>


### [294] [From Retrieval to Customer Context: Evaluating Frontier-Model Systems for Voice-of-Customer Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09375)
*Raviraja G,Viraj Bagal,Prabhath Chellingi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"客户上下文图"（Customer Context Graph），将客户对象、运营对象与分析/行动对象通过类型化关系统一建模，让智能体不仅能回答客户"说了什么"，还能追溯"为何说、谁受影响、采取了什么行动、谁负责、是否解决"。在9,432条公开Cursor反馈、30个真实问题上对比Agentic RAG、Deep Research Agent与图-backed Agent，后者综合得分0.961，显著优于0.710与0.651。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业日益使用前沿语言模型分析客户反馈，但答案质量不仅取决于模型本身，也取决于反馈如何被组织和提供。传统RAG仅基于文本相似度检索，缺乏对客户与业务上下文的结构化关联，难以回答"为什么、谁受影响、后续行动与结果"等深层问题，因此需要一个统一的上下文模型来支撑智能体推理。

Method: 定义客户上下文图为客户与业务上下文的统一模型，用类型化关系连接三类对象：客户对象（反馈、对话、用户、账户）、运营对象（工单、客服、商机、竞品）、分析/行动对象（分类概念、证据、洞察、工作项、结果）。实验基于公开Cursor反馈构建图谱，比较Agentic RAG、Deep Research Agent与图-backed Agent在9,432条记录、30个产品/事故/对比/元数据问题上的表现。无完整ground truth情况下，采用比较性评分准则（在30题中的28题上校准），从答案质量（覆盖度与组织性）、分析深度（具体性与分解度）、证据质量（引用支持与可追溯性）三维度联合评分，并对引用记录与其论断进行抽样核验，三维度等权。

Result: 在统一准则下，客户上下文图-backed Agent综合得分0.961，Deep Research Agent为0.710，Agentic RAG为0.651。图-backed Agent在30对配对问题中的27题上领先Deep Research Agent（符号检验p < 10^(-5)，其中26题严格最优）。其最大优势体现在分析深度（0.967 vs 0.642），表现为更具体、层次化展开的发现，含量化主题与可追溯证据。

Conclusion: 结构化、关系化的客户上下文图谱能显著提升智能体分析客户反馈的答案质量、分析深度与证据可追溯性，优于单纯的Agentic RAG与Deep Research Agent。该架构在公开Cursor反馈上验证，但可迁移至任意反馈来源，为组织级反馈分析提供了可扩展的统一上下文建模范式。

Abstract: Organizations increasingly use frontier language models to analyze customer feedback, but answer quality also depends on how that feedback is organized and made available. We define a \emph{customer context graph} as a unified model of customer and business context. Typed relationships connect customer objects (feedback, conversations, users, and accounts), operational objects (tickets, support agents, opportunities, and competitors), and analytical or action objects (taxonomy concepts, evidence, insights, work items, and outcomes). This lets an agent investigate not only what customers say, but why, who is affected, what action followed, who owns it, and whether it was resolved. For this experiment, the graph is populated from public Cursor feedback; the same architecture can support any type of feedback source. We compare Agentic RAG, a Deep Research Agent, and a Customer Context Graph-backed Agent on the same 9,432 public Cursor feedback records using 30 realistic product, incident, comparison, and metadata questions. Without exhaustive ground truth, we jointly score responses on answer quality (coverage and organization), analytical depth (specificity and decomposition), and evidence quality (citation support and traceability), using a comparative rubric calibrated on 28 of the 30 questions. We sample cited records against their claims and weight the three dimensions equally. Under this aligned rubric, the Customer Context Graph-backed Agent scores 0.961 overall, versus 0.710 for the Deep Research Agent and 0.651 for Agentic RAG, and leads the Deep Research Agent on 27 of 30 paired questions (sign-test p < 10^(-5); strictly best on 26 of 30). Its largest advantage is analytical depth (0.967 versus 0.642), reflecting more specific, hierarchically developed findings with quantified themes and traceable evidence...

</details>


### [295] [Noise, Denoise, Correct: MCMC Posterior Sampling with Diffusion Priors in Three Steps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09407)
*So Takao,Gregory David Bellchambers,Luke Ye,Sanmitra Ghosh,Michalis Michaelides*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 diffusion waltz，一种基于 SDEdit 式加噪-去噪作提议、用 Metropolis-Hastings 校正的 MCMC 方法，实现无需评估先验的精确后验采样，并可结合无梯度集合卡尔曼更新注入观测，在非可微 Navier-Stokes 初值恢复任务上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型虽是逆问题的强大先验，但在非线性、不可微前向模型下的后验采样仍然困难；现有方法往往依赖可微性、梯度或先验密度评估。

Method: 以 SDEdit 风格的加噪-去噪过程作为 MCMC 提议分布，通过 Metropolis-Hastings 接受-拒绝步骤进行校正，从而得到精确后验样本且无需先验评估；进一步用无梯度的集合卡尔曼更新将观测注入提议分布，同时保持采样精确性。

Result: 在不可微的 Navier-Stokes 初始条件恢复任务上，diffusion waltz 在不同噪声水平与非线性强度区间均优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: diffusion waltz 为非线性、非可微逆问题提供了一种精确且无需先验评估的后验采样框架，并通过无梯度观测注入提升提议质量，展现了在复杂物理反演任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Pretrained diffusion models are powerful priors for inverse problems, but posterior sampling under nonlinear, non-differentiable forward models remain hard. We introduce diffusion waltz, an MCMC method using SDEdit-style noising-denoising as a proposal, corrected via Metropolis-Hastings for exact posterior sampling without prior evaluation. We further propose injecting observations into the proposal while preserving exactness, using a gradient-free ensemble Kalman update. On a non-differentiable Navier-Stokes initial condition recovery task, diffusion waltz outperforms existing baselines across different noise and nonlinearity regimes.

</details>


### [296] [Stability and Diversity of Networked Self-Consuming Generative Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09409)
*Xiukun Wei,Yang Zhang,Xueru Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了"网络化自消耗生成模型"的理论框架，将多个生成模型建模为有向加权图中的节点，边权控制合成数据流动，分析了重训练动态下的长期收敛性、不动点及稳定性与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI广泛部署使得合成数据不可避免地进入未来模型的训练流程，形成自消耗训练循环。已有研究多局限于单模型自消耗或两模型简化交互，缺乏对多模型相互消耗合成数据这一网络化场景的理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 构建理论框架，将模型表示为有向加权图的节点，边权刻画模型间合成数据的流向。在该框架下分析网络化模型在重训练动态下的长期行为，建立收敛条件并刻画所得不动点；进一步考察各模型对真实数据的可及性、跨模型数据消耗以及交互图结构对系统长期稳定性与多样性的影响。

Result: 建立了网络化自消耗模型的收敛条件，刻画了系统的不动点，并揭示了真实数据可及性、跨模型数据消耗及交互图结构如何共同决定系统的长期稳定性与多样性。

Conclusion: 该工作首次将递归自消耗训练分析从孤立模型与双模型交互推广至网络化多模型场景，为理解和预测生成模型生态中合成数据循环的长期后果提供了理论工具。

Abstract: The widespread deployment of generative AI has made it increasingly difficult to distinguish synthetic content from real data. Consequently, synthetic data is inevitably incorporated into the training pipelines of future model generations, forming a self-consuming training loop. Prior work has studied the effects of such recursive self-consuming training, but analyses have largely been limited to isolated models, where a model consumes only its own synthetic data, or to simplified interactions between two models. This paper takes a first step toward understanding networked self-consuming generative models, in which multiple models consume synthetic data generated by one another through complex interaction pathways. We introduce a theoretical framework representing models as nodes in a directed, weighted graph, with edge weights governing the flow of synthetic data among models. Using this framework, we analyze the long-term behavior of networked models under retraining dynamics, establishing conditions for convergence and characterizing the resulting fixed points. We further investigate how the system's long-term stability and diversity are shaped by each model's access to real data, cross-model data consumption, and the structure of the interaction graph.

</details>


### [297] [Shared Geometry As A Rosetta Stone: Cross-Modal Alignment Without Paired Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09411)
*Dominik Schnaus,Thomas Dagès,Daniel Cremers,Xi Wang,Phillip Isola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发现独立训练的单模态模型往往天然共享几何结构，因此无需配对样本即可实现粗粒度跨模态对齐。作者提出 Wasserstein Procrustes 方法，仅用一个正交映射在无配对条件下对齐两组不相交的嵌入集合，并在少配对场景下显著优于现有方法，还可支持无配对的文本到图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态表示可支持零样本分类与检索，但传统上对齐独立训练的模型需要大量配对数据。Platonic Representation Hypothesis 提示不同模态训练的模型可能自发收敛到共享表示几何，这引出了核心问题：跨模态对齐是否真的需要配对样本。

Method: 提出 Wasserstein Procrustes 方法，结合粗粒度几何初始化，在没有配对样本的情况下通过估计单个正交映射来对齐两个不相交的嵌入集合；同时在有少量配对样本时可自然融入配对信息以提升性能。

Result: 在跨数据集、跨模态和单模态模型的实验中，方法能在无配对条件下稳定对齐独立训练的表示，且标准几何对齐指标可准确预测对齐可行性。在极少配对样本场景下显著优于现有方法，在增加配对样本后仍具竞争力，并成功实现无配对的文本到图像生成。

Conclusion: 独立训练的模型通常共享足够的几何结构，使得仅凭极少甚至无需配对数据即可建立跨模态对应关系；配对样本并非粗粒度跨模态对齐的必要条件。

Abstract: Multimodal representations enable zero-shot classification and retrieval, but aligning independently trained models usually requires large amounts of paired data. Yet, the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that models trained on different modalities may converge spontaneously toward a shared representation geometry. But then, do we even need paired examples for cross-modal alignment? Remarkably, we show that paired examples are unnecessary for coarse cross-modal alignment. Our simple Wasserstein Procrustes method with a coarse geometric initialization aligns two disjoint embedding sets by estimating a single orthogonal map without seeing any pairs. Across datasets, modalities, and unimodal models, we show that we can consistently align independently trained representations without pairs, and standard geometric alignment metrics accurately predict when this is possible. Nevertheless, we can naturally benefit from paired examples. In the very few-pair regime, our method substantially outperforms existing ones, while staying competitive with pair-based methods with more added examples. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting alignments can enable text-to-image generation without paired examples. These results show that independently trained models often share enough geometry to establish cross-modal correspondence with little or no paired data.

</details>


### [298] [Self-Consuming Generative Models with Co-Evolving Human Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09415)
*Xiukun Wei,Tian Xie,Ding Zhu,Xueru Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文首次研究生成模型"自消费"迭代训练中模型分布与用户偏好共同演化的耦合动力学，揭示纯用户策展合成数据会导致初始偏差放大并趋向单点均衡，而注入足量参考数据可实现唯一全局吸引均衡，并提出联合优化参考分布与混合权重的算法以导向理想均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型日益采用"自消费"迭代循环训练：用户从模型生成候选中筛选偏好样本，再用这些样本训练下一代模型。已有工作大多假设用户偏好固定，但实际上模型输出的暴露会逐渐重塑用户对"理想样本"的认知，从而形成模型分布与用户偏好共同演化的反馈回路。论文旨在迈出理解这种耦合长期动力学行为的第一步。

Method: 论文从理论与算法两个层面展开：首先建模模型分布与用户偏好共同演化的耦合迭代动力学，分析纯用户策展合成数据下的长期行为；其次分析在训练中以足够大的比率注入参考数据对动力学的影响；在此基础上，研究利用参考数据注入控制长期结果，并提出一种高效算法，联合选择参考分布及其混合权重，使耦合系统导向既保留期望属性又最小化数据收集成本的均衡。

Result: 当训练完全依赖用户策展的合成数据时，迭代策展会放大初始偏差，使系统趋向多个单点均衡之一——初始占优的实例最终主导整个系统。相反，当以足够大的比率向训练中注入参考数据时，动力学性质发生根本改变，产生唯一的全局吸引均衡。

Conclusion: 参考数据注入是控制耦合系统长期行为的有效手段。基于该洞察提出的算法能够联合优化参考分布与混合权重，将系统导向保留期望属性同时最小化数据收集成本的均衡，为自消费生成模型的可持续训练提供了理论指导与实用工具。

Abstract: Generative models are increasingly trained in self-consuming iterative loops, where users curate preferred samples from model-generated candidates and the curated samples are used to train future generations of the model. Prior work has largely assumed fixed user preferences, but in practice exposure to model outputs gradually reshapes what users perceive as desirable, creating a feedback loop in which model distributions and user preferences co-evolve. We take a first step toward understanding the long-term behavior of such coupled dynamics. We show that when training relies entirely on user-curated synthetic data, iterative curation amplifies initial biases and drives the system toward one of multiple singleton equilibria in which the instance holding an initial advantage eventually dominates. In contrast, injecting reference data into training at a sufficiently large rate fundamentally changes the dynamics and yields a unique globally attracting equilibrium. Building on this insight, we study how reference-data injection can be used to control long-term outcomes, and propose an efficient algorithm that jointly selects a reference distribution and its mixing weight to steer the coupled system toward equilibria that preserve desired attributes while minimizing data collection costs.

</details>


### [299] [What a Reporting Convention Hides: A Matched-Budget Audit of Quantum Natural Gradient with an Exactly Computed Metric](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09425)
*Lu Wei,Yufeng Wang,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文考察了变分量子优化器比较中两种计时惯例（仅计入达标运行 vs. 在单一目标处判定）对结论的影响，发现惯例选择会改变 Adam、SPSA 与 QNG 之间的优劣判断，并建议对所有未达标运行计入预算、跨多个目标报告结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有变分量子优化器的比较要么只计时达到目标损失的运行，要么只在单一目标处读取结论，这两种惯例都可能决定"更昂贵的优化步骤是否值得"。作者希望量化这两种惯例究竟在多大程度上改变 Adam、SPSA 和 QNG 之间的优劣判定。

Method: 在与设置选择相独立的留出初始化上比较 Adam、SPSA 与 QNG；精确计算 QNG 预条件所用的度量（metric）；将每一步都按电路评估次数计价，并给所有方法相同预算。在电路宽度、代价函数族及包含共同未达标情况的设置扫描上取中位数，并分别考察宽松目标与严格目标，同时对比度量在模拟器上（代价随参数数线性增长）与假设硬件上（二次增长）的计价差异。

Result: 在跨电路宽度、代价函数族与设置扫描的中位数汇总中，达到宽松目标时 SPSA 所需的评估次数超过 Adam 的两倍；若剔除未达标的删失运行，这一差距就被掩盖。在全局代价函数族上固定为严格目标所选设置时，QNG 通常在 Adam 之后达到宽松目标、但最先达到严格目标；当把 QNG 度量的模拟器价格（随参数数线性）换成假设的硬件价格（随参数数二次）后，QNG 在严格目标上的领先优势消失。

Conclusion: 计时与判定惯例会实质性地改变优化器之间的优劣结论。作者建议：对所有未达标（miss）的运行都计入完整预算，并跨多个目标报告结论，以避免删失运行和单一目标判定带来的偏差。

Abstract: Several published comparisons of variational quantum optimizers time only runs that reach a target loss, or read the verdict at a single target. Either convention could decide whether an optimizer's costlier steps pay off. We measure how much each convention changes verdicts among Adam, simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA) and quantum natural gradient (QNG), on initializations held out from the selection of settings. We compute the exact metric that preconditions QNG, price every step in circuit evaluations and give every method the same budget. In a median pooled over circuit widths, cost families and a sweep of settings with common misses, SPSA needs more than twice Adam's evaluations to reach a loose target. Dropping the censored runs that miss the target hides this gap. On the global-cost family we hold fixed the settings selected for a strict target. QNG then usually reaches the loose target after Adam but the strict target first. QNG's strict-target lead disappears when the metric's simulator price, linear in the number of parameters, is replaced by an assumed hardware count quadratic in that number. We recommend charging every miss the budget and reporting verdicts across targets.

</details>


### [300] [An extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09433)
*Han Zhang,Mehrisadat Makki Alamdari,Babak Shahbodagh,Mohammad Vahab,Cosmin Anitescu,Timon Rabczuk,Elena Atroshchenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出扩展深度能量法，用两个神经网络分别表示温度与位移场，裂纹以尖锐折线表示，实现了热-力耦合下的裂纹扩展模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经能量求解器已用于相场断裂，并能通过网络输入表示尖锐裂纹，但尚未将裂纹域上的热传导与热应力驱动的裂纹扩展统一处理，缺乏同时求解温度场、位移场与裂纹演化的热-力耦合框架。

Method: 构建扩展深度能量法：裂纹保持为尖锐折线；两个网络分别输出温度与位移，并通过跨裂纹间断、其余区域光滑的标量嵌入函数接收裂纹信息，使两个场无需正则化长度即可跳跃；裂尖位移由Williams展开富集，振幅可训练。采用交错序列分别最小化增量热传导泛函与热弹性势能，蒙特卡洛积分点按背景单元分层、裂尖加密并在训练中重绘。应力强度因子由含Wilson-Yu面积项的相互作用积分提取，并用围道半径扫描校验；当裂尖温度下扭折的能量释放率达临界值时，裂纹沿最大环向应力角扩展。

Result: 在静止热边缘裂纹上，提取的应力强度因子与文献值误差0.11%；在功能梯度剪切试验中，起裂预测与独立尖锐裂纹有限元解相差不超过一个载荷步；在缺口十字形试样上，机械、热及组合载荷下的裂纹路径均与已有解一致。

Conclusion: 该扩展深度能量法能够在无需正则化长度的情况下统一求解热传导、位移场与尖锐裂纹扩展，验证结果与文献及有限元解高度吻合，表明其适用于热-力耦合断裂问题。

Abstract: Thermo-mechanical fracture couples transient heat conduction on a cracked domain with a crack that grows as the temperature and the displacement evolve. Neural energy solvers have been proposed for phase-field fracture and later extended to represent a sharp crack through the network input, but heat conduction on the cracked domain and crack propagation under the resulting thermal stresses have not yet been treated together in these solvers. We present an extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation in which the crack remains a sharp polyline. Two networks represent the temperature and the displacement and receive the crack through a scalar embedding function, discontinuous across the crack and smooth elsewhere, so that both fields can jump across it without a regularization length, and the displacement is enriched near the tip by the Williams expansion with trainable amplitudes. The two fields are obtained by minimizing an incremental conduction functional and the thermoelastic potential energy in a staggered sequence, with Monte Carlo integration on points stratified over background elements, densified near the tip and redrawn during training. The stress intensity factors are extracted by the interaction integral with the area term of Wilson and Yu and checked by a sweep of the contour radius, and the crack advances at the maximum hoop stress angle when the energy release rate of the kink reaches the critical value at the crack-tip temperature. On a stationary thermal edge crack the extracted stress intensity factor agrees with the published value to 0.11%, in a functionally graded shear test initiation agrees with an independent sharp-crack finite element solution to within one load step, and on a notched cruciform specimen the crack paths follow the published solutions under mechanical, thermal and combined loading.

</details>


### [301] [CHASE: Channel-Aligned Structure Exploitation for Geometry-Aware Model Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09476)
*Wei Wang,Wei Jiang,Ziran Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CHASE 框架，将 GSA（几何与谱对齐）所刻画的网络结构直接用于模型修改、重构与压缩，涵盖 CORA、COEC、CORAM、CAGA、SAKV、CAPS 六项应用，实验证明该结构可有效指导微调、剪枝补偿、模型合并、GQA 转换、KV 缓存压缩与结构化剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GSA 已能通过谱集中、物理通道对齐、支撑结构与奇异基变化来刻画训练后的网络，但这些结构此前多停留在分析层面，缺少在实际模型设计中的系统性应用。本文旨在把 GSA 识别的结构转化为可落地的模型操作与设计方法。

Method: 提出 CHASE（Channel-Aligned Structure Exploitation）框架，覆盖模型修改、重构与压缩三类操作共六项应用。其中 CORA、COEC、CORAM 分别将 GSA 用于参数高效微调、结构化剪枝补偿与模型合并。另提出三种新方法：CAGA 利用 GSA 识别可共享 KV 表示的多头注意力头，通过几何对齐与低秩子空间提取构建共享的 key/value 头；SAKV 利用 GSA 判定可共享低秩 KV 缓存表示的相邻层及各层组保留秩；CAPS 利用 GSA 的谱结构对输出神经元分组，并为每组单独选择保留的输入通道。

Result: CORA、COEC、CORAM 的结果验证了 GSA 在适配、剪枝补偿与模型合并上的有效性。CAGA 实验表明，几何共享头构建显著改善 MHA 到 GQA 的转换；SAKV 与 CAPS 在 KV 缓存压缩与结构化剪枝上均优于代表性基线方法。

Conclusion: GSA 所识别的网络结构可直接用于设计面向多种模型操作的方法，表明结构驱动的设计思路在模型修改、重构与压缩任务中具有通用性与实用价值。

Abstract: Geometric and Spectral Alignment (GSA) characterizes trained networks through spectral concentration, physical-channel alignment, support structure, and changes in singular bases. In this paper, we propose CHASE (Channel-Aligned Structure Exploitation) to use these structures in practical model design. CHASE covers six applications across model modification, reconfiguration, and compression. CORA, COEC, and CORAM apply GSA to parameter-efficient finetuning, structured-pruning compensation, and model merging. We further develop three new methods. CAGA uses GSA to identify multi-head attention heads that can share a KV representation and constructs the shared key and value heads through geometric alignment and low-rank subspace extraction. SAKV uses GSA to determine which adjacent layers can share a low-rank KV-cache representation and the retained rank for each layer group. CAPS uses GSA spectral structure to group output neurons and selects retained input channels separately for each group. Results from CORA, COEC, and CORAM establish the effectiveness of GSA for adaptation, pruning compensation, and model merging. Experiments on CAGA show that geometric shared-head construction substantially improves MHA-to-GQA conversion, and SAKV and CAPS improve over representative baselines for KV-cache compression and structured pruning. These results show that the structures identified by GSA can be used directly to design methods for a range of model operations.

</details>


### [302] [GeoPrior-Mamba: Structured Process Priors with Mamba for Fine-Resolution XCO2 Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09456)
*Zhao Meng,Yinan Cai,Siru Zhong,Juepeng Zheng,Haohuan Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GeoPrior-Mamba，用语言模型离线构建结构化过程先验并注入多方向 Mamba 重建骨干，从稀疏 OCO-2 观测重建高分辨率 XCO2 场，RMSE 0.81 ppm、R² 0.93。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏卫星观测重建精细分辨率 XCO2 场时，空间结构受直接观测约束较弱。现有学习方法将环境协变量视为普通数值输入，需在稀疏监督下学习异质的源汇关系，难度大且约束不足。

Method: GeoPrior-Mamba：多方向 Mamba 框架 + 离线语言模型诱导的结构化过程先验。语言模型不用于预测 XCO2，而在训练前将生物圈吸收、生态系统呼吸和人为排放的相对过程知识组织为确定性先验表；再结合地理、生态、排放及季节信息进行空间实例化，通过轻量级知识适配器自适应注入重建骨干。

Result: 基于 2018–2020 年 OCO-2 观测：留出观测上 RMSE 0.81 ppm、R² 0.93；相同评估协议下较 CAMS 背景插值 RMSE 降低 48.2%，较 Trans-XCO2 降低 3.1%。消融显示知识先验分支有可测贡献，且收敛显著快于无知识 Mamba 骨干。独立 TCCON 评估支持重建场与地基柱 CO2 测量的一致性。

Conclusion: 当全球一致的过程-响应表征难以直接获取时，语言模型可作为构建结构化过程先验的实用机制，且始终处于数值预测回路之外。

Abstract: Reconstructing fine-resolution column-averaged dry-air CO2 (XCO2) fields from sparse satellite observations requires models to infer spatial structure that is only weakly constrained by direct measurements. Existing learning-based methods typically treat environmental covariates as ordinary numerical inputs and must therefore learn heterogeneous source-sink relationships largely from sparse supervision. We introduce GeoPrior-Mamba, a multi-directional Mamba framework augmented with offline language-model-induced structured process priors. Rather than using a language model to predict XCO2, we use it before training to organize relative process knowledge for biospheric uptake, ecosystem respiration, and anthropogenic emissions into deterministic prior tables. These priors are spatially instantiated using geographic, ecological, emission-related, and seasonal information and are adaptively injected into the reconstruction backbone through a lightweight knowledge adapter. Using OCO-2 observations from 2018-2020, GeoPrior-Mamba achieves an RMSE of 0.81 ppm and an R2 of 0.93 on held-out observations, reducing RMSE by 48.2% relative to CAMS background interpolation and by 3.1% relative to Trans-XCO2 under the same evaluation protocol. Ablation experiments show a measurable contribution from the knowledge-prior branch and substantially faster convergence than the knowledge-free Mamba backbone. Independent TCCON evaluation further supports the consistency of the reconstructed fields with ground-based column CO2 measurements. These results suggest that language models can provide a practical mechanism for constructing structured process priors when globally consistent process-response representations are difficult to obtain directly, while remaining outside the numerical prediction loop.

</details>


### [303] [Collaborative Reasoning Distillation via Cross-Feedback and Coherent Curation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09587)
*Taehoon Kim,Seunggeun Cho,Dongsu Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出协作推理蒸馏（CRD）框架，通过交互式交叉反馈、细粒度步骤级质量评估和连贯性感知的步骤拼接，结合带预算约束的推理质量优化（RQO）训练紧凑模型，CRD-4B在MATH-500达97.3%、AIME'25达70.3%，且仅用50K训练样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前提升大语言模型推理能力的方法要么需要巨大计算预算，要么难以有效将推理蒸馏到小模型。标准蒸馏方法依赖结果导向奖励，无法区分严密推理与侥幸猜对。

Method: CRD框架包含三项创新：(1) 交互式交叉反馈，教师模型迭代互评彼此的推理；(2) 细粒度步骤级质量评估，独立于最终答案捕捉逻辑有效性；(3) 连贯性感知的步骤拼接，综合各模型的互补优势。学生模型通过带预算约束的推理质量优化（RQO）进行训练。

Result: CRD-4B在MATH-500上达到97.3%，在AIME'25上达到70.3%，超越基线模型，且仅使用50K训练样本，数据集规模比同类模型最多小12倍。

Conclusion: CRD通过过程导向的步骤级蒸馏与交叉反馈机制，有效提升了紧凑模型的推理能力，在显著减少训练数据的同时取得了领先性能。

Abstract: Reasoning capabilities are critical for advancing Large Language Models, yet current approaches either require massive computational budgets or struggle to effectively distill reasoning to smaller models. Standard distillation methods rely on outcome-based rewards, failing to distinguish between sound reasoning and lucky guesses. We propose Collaborative Reasoning Distillation (CRD), a framework that enhances reasoning in compact models through three innovations: (1) interactive cross-feedback where teachers iteratively critique each other's reasoning, (2) fine-grained step-wise quality assessment capturing logical validity independent of final answers, and (3) coherence-aware step stitching that synthesizes complementary strengths. Students are trained via Reasoning Quality Optimization (RQO) with budget constraints. Our model, CRD-4B, achieves 97.3% on MATH-500 and 70.3% on AIME'25, surpassing baselines while using only 50K training examples, up to 12 times smaller than the datasets of comparable models.

</details>


### [304] [DSReg: Provably Recovering Individual World Latents without Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09457)
*Yujia Zheng,David Klindt,Randall Balestriero,Bernhard Schölkopf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DSReg（依赖稀疏正则化），在无重建、无解码器、无标签条件下，借助"结构多样性"条件，将 JEPA 的线性可辨识表示进一步恢复为个体世界隐变量（至符号置换），构建首个完全可辨识的 JEPA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有隐变量恢复方法（非线性 ICA、字典学习、因果表示学习）依赖重建、辅助监督或非高斯性等分布不对称作为锚点；而 JEPA 等无锚方法仅能辨识到线性变换，个体隐变量仍相互混合。作者希望在不引入上述锚点的前提下实现个体世界隐变量的可证明恢复。

Method: 提出结构多样性（Structural Diversity）条件：不同隐变量在观测上留下不同的依赖"足迹"（类似每片雪花独一无二）。在此基础上，基于 LeJEPA 提供的线性可辨识性，提出 DSReg（Dependency-Sparsity Regularization）；其作为后处理步骤施加于任意线性可辨识表示，可复用已训练检查点，无需重建或解码器。

Result: 理论上证明在结构多样性下 DSReg 可将个体世界隐变量恢复至符号置换，且结构多样性严格弱于此前可辨识潜变量模型的各类结构条件；实验覆盖合成数据、世界模型探针、学习到的视觉编码器与外部渲染器，DSReg 在保持密集预测性能的同时提升了单个隐变量的恢复效果及下游任务表现，并具可扩展性。

Conclusion: DSReg 在无重建、无解码器、无标签条件下实现了单个世界隐变量的可证明恢复，建立了首个完全可辨识的 JEPA；这是比既往更弱的结构性条件，且可作为即插即用的后处理模块。

Abstract: Methods that recover individual latent variables of the world, from nonlinear ICA to dictionary learning and causal representation learning, anchor the latents to observations through reconstruction, auxiliary supervision, or distributional asymmetries such as non-Gaussianity. Methods without these anchors, including joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs), identify the latent state only up to a linear transformation, so individual latents remain mixed. We close this gap: individual world latents can be provably recovered with no reconstruction, no decoder, and no labels. The key condition is Structural Diversity: different latents leave distinct dependency footprints on observations, just as no two snowflakes are alike. Building on the linear identifiability that LeJEPA provides, we prove that under Structural Diversity, DSReg (Dependency-Sparsity Regularization) recovers individual world latents up to signed permutation, without reconstruction or a decoder. It applies post hoc to any linearly identified representation, reusing trained checkpoints at no loss over joint training, and establishes the first fully identifiable JEPA that recovers every world latent. Moreover, as a condition on dependency footprints, Structural Diversity is strictly weaker than all structural conditions of prior identifiable latent variable models. Across synthetic regimes, world model probes, learned visual encoders, and external renderers, DSReg preserves dense prediction while improving individual-latent recovery and downstream use with scales.

</details>


### [305] [Coding-Agent Benchmarks Should Match Their Users' Task Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09633)
*Igor Slinko,Yaroslav Golubev,Sergey Titov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过采集4,782个真实IDE中工程师的智能体会话（Production Sessions），发现真实长会话的任务类型分布与类型切换模式（Task Flow）与issue派生基准任务显著不同，且不同公开语料间也存在差异，因此提出SWE-TaskFlow方法将任意issue派生基准转换为目标Task Flow，并给出TFAS对齐评分；在700个SWE-Bench Pro任务上的试点表明，多步顺序求解约使成本翻倍却未带来稳定的解决率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体评测追求"尽可能真实"，但通常直接采用issue派生的基准任务，缺乏对真实交互分布的测量依据。作者希望用真实生产环境中的智能体会话数据，检验基准任务在任务类型组合与会话内类型切换上是否具备代表性，从而说明交互协议本身应成为评测的重要维度。

Method: 采集JetBrains IDE中真实软件工程师的4,782个智能体会话（Production Sessions），聚焦至少三条用户消息的长会话（占33%）；对比长会话样本与三个公开交互语料的Task Flow（会话长度、任务类型、类型间转移的分布）。提出SWE-TaskFlow：在保留已验证任务与测试的前提下，通过prompt splitting与可验证的仓库QA将交互引导至目标Task Flow，并用TaskFlow Alignment Score（TFAS）在生成的轨迹中择优。

Result: 真实长会话与issue派生基准存在两点差异：用户请求涵盖更广的任务类型（代码提问、规划、评审、重构、执行），且用户会在会话中在多种类型间切换。三个公开交互语料的长会话样本Task Flow差异显著，说明不存在普适的"真实"交互分布。在700个SWE-Bench Pro任务的试点中，将任务拆分为多步顺序求解约使智能体成本翻倍，而解决率无稳定变化。

Conclusion: 基准评测应明确目标用例，并以该用例的实测数据校准交互分布；交互协议本身是评测的重要维度，不能被issue派生任务的形式所隐含替代。SWE-TaskFlow与TFAS为将现有基准对齐到指定Task Flow提供了可行路径。

Abstract: The evaluation of coding agents generally strives to be as realistic as possible. In our study, we collect 4,782 agent sessions of real software engineers in JetBrains IDEs, which we call Production Sessions. Since our subject is interactive agents, we study the sessions with at least three user messages (33% of the sample). These long sessions differ from issue-derived benchmark tasks in two ways: (i) user requests span a far wider mix of task types - questions about the project's code, planning, review, refactoring, execution - and (ii) users switch between types throughout a session. Long-session samples from three public interaction corpora exhibit markedly different Task Flows (the distributions of session lengths, task types, and type-to-type transitions), so no single interaction distribution is universally realistic: benchmarks should name a target use case and calibrate to measurements from it. We present SWE-TaskFlow, an approach for transforming any issue-derived benchmark: it preserves the verified tasks and tests while steering the interaction toward a target Task Flow through prompt splitting and verifiable repository QA, with a TaskFlow Alignment Score (TFAS) for selecting among generated trajectories. In a pilot on 700 SWE-Bench Pro tasks, solving the task sequentially in several steps approximately doubles agent cost without a stable change in resolve rate: the interaction protocol itself is an important dimension of evaluation.

</details>


### [306] [When Should an In-Context Learner Expand Its Hypothesis Space?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09471)
*Weihan Li,Xinlei Chen,Junhao Wu,Tianshi Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"结构性修正"的成本化序贯决策框架，构建 Structural Revision Environment 并给出精确贝叶斯与规范解，发现"修正"是价值边界而非证据阈值；Transformer 可从效用中复现边界，而现有 LLM 存在失败敏感信号与修正决策脱钩的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习系统在熟悉的模型族内能快速适应，但更困难的是更早一步的决策：当观测可能是噪声、例外、族内变化或族外结构时，判断"是否值得付出成本开启更丰富的模型族"。作者希望把这一"何时扩展模型族"的问题形式化为可计算、可检验的成本化序贯决策问题。

Method: 构建 Structural Revision Environment：为每个来源生成匹配的失败样本；独立于证据地调节扩展价格与剩余时间步；支持精确贝叶斯计算与单步决策的精确规范解。并在该环境中训练 Transformer、测试三条后训练谱系的语言模型，以及允许推理的模型与受控后训练变体。

Result: 规范解显示修正由价值边界而非证据阈值决定：同一历史在不同价格、时间与前查询下最优行动不同；局部修复与扩展的边界由规则无法覆盖的预测输入决定；对更丰富族的信念远早于决策本身越界。环境训练的 Transformer 仅凭效用即可复现该边界。三个后训练谱系的 LLM 预测含失败敏感信号但未反映到修正决策中，且只读取扩展收益、不权衡价格与时间；三种允许推理的模型按参考比例权衡收益，却仍不能把历史转化为"扩展能带来什么"的估计。受控后训练可移动先验与预测锐度，但均不移动判定准则。

Conclusion: 结构性修正本质上是一个价值判断问题：其判据由效用（价格、时间、查询）而非证据强度决定。当前语言模型在预测层面具备失败敏感性，但在决策层面缺少将证据转化为扩展价值的机制，且推理与后训练均未改变该判定准则。

Abstract: Learning systems adapt quickly inside a familiar family of models. The harder step comes earlier: deciding, from observations that could be noise, an exception, a change within the family or structure outside it, whether opening a richer family is worth its cost. We treat this as a costly sequential decision: prediction failure must be turned into structural evidence, evidence into a value of expansion, and value into action. The Structural Revision Environment produces matched failures from each source, varies the price of expansion and the remaining horizon independently of the evidence, and admits exact Bayesian calculations and an exact normative solution of the one-shot decision. Its solution shows that revision is a value boundary and not an evidence threshold: one history has different optimal actions under different prices, horizons and announced queries, the boundary between local repair and expansion is set by the inputs a rule predicts and a repair cannot cover, and belief in the richer family crosses long before the decision does. Transformers trained in the environment reproduce this boundary from utility alone. Language models of three post-training lineages carry a failure-sensitive signal in their predictions that is not reflected in their revision decisions, and given the gain of expanding they read it without weighing it against price and horizon. Three models allowed to reason weigh the stated gain in the reference's proportions and still do not turn the history into an estimate of what expansion would buy. Controlled post-training of the meta-trained learners moves the prior and the sharpness of predictions, and neither moves the criterion.

</details>


### [307] [When Rank Rises as LLMs Degrade](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09647)
*Zhaohui Geoffrey Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对 Qwen3-0.6B 的后训练受控实验表明,秩并不总在表征退化时下降:数据重复会使 RankMe 与协方差有效秩上升(谱弥散而非坍缩),使单侧监控将最差检查点判为最健康;方向性依赖于"退化模式—统计量"配对,不能靠重校准修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践者常用 RankMe 等谱统计量监控表示健康度,并默认"秩下降=表征退化"。作者要检验这一假设在 LLM 后训练的非平稳环境下是否安全,以及谱监控能否比留出损失更早预警。

Method: 在 Qwen3-0.6B 上做受控研究,设置四种退化模式、三个随机种子;对比原始与中心化 RankMe、协方差有效秩、k95 等统计量;并区分 RankMe(奇异值归一化)与协方差有效秩(特征值归一化)的定义差异,分析预训练模型原始中间层状态中的大规模激活影响;最后构建双侧多通道序贯监控器,采用独立校准/测试数据与预注册的共享前缀、留一种子评估。

Result: 数据重复使留出损失相对健康状态恶化 75%,同时原始与中心化 RankMe 均上升(中心化 RankMe 变化达 13.5 个合并标准差),协方差有效秩升至健康值近两倍;学习率配置错误则降低中心化 RankMe 与 k95,而未中心化 RankMe 跨种子不一致。监控器在每折中于分叉后 10–60 步检出全部三种损伤模式,并可由触发方向区分弥散型与降秩型损伤,但从不早于留出探针损失,且用两个种子校准时会在留出健康种子上产生误报。

Conclusion: 谱监控可用于诊断失效模式,方向性是"regime–statistic"配对的属性而非可通过重校准修正的常数;原始中间层状态中大规模激活会压缩协方差有效秩的可用范围;谱监控并不比留出损失更早预警,且有效性声明必须依赖留出健康数据支撑。

Abstract: Post-training adapts language models in non-stationary environments. Practitioners monitor representation health with RankMe and related spectral statistics, often assuming that rank falls when representations degrade. We show that this assumption is unsafe for LLM post-training. In a controlled study of Qwen3-0.6B with four degradation modes and three seeds, data duplication worsens held-out loss by 75% relative to healthy while increasing both original and centred RankMe; the latter changes by 13.5 pooled standard deviations. Covariance effective rank rises to nearly twice its healthy value. This failure is spectral dispersion rather than collapse, so a one-sided monitor rates the worst checkpoint as the healthiest. By contrast, a learning-rate misconfiguration lowers centred RankMe and k95, while uncentred RankMe is inconsistent across seeds. Direction is therefore a property of the regime-statistic pair and cannot be fixed by recalibration alone. We also distinguish two often-conflated statistics: RankMe normalises singular values, whereas covariance effective rank normalises eigenvalues. On raw intermediate-layer states in the pretrained model, massive activations pin the latter near 1 out of dimension d while RankMe retains usable range. We then test a two-sided, multichannel sequential monitor with separate calibration and test data. In a pre-registered shared-prefix, leave-one-seed-out evaluation, it detects all three damage regimes in every fold 10 to 60 steps after the fork and separates dispersion from downward-rank damage by firing direction. However, it never precedes held-out probe loss, and calibration with two seeds produces false alarms on the held-out healthy seed. Spectral monitoring can diagnose failure regimes, but it does not warn earlier than held-out loss, and validity claims require held-out healthy data.

</details>


### [308] [MORA: Modeling Observed Changes for Drift-Robust Time-Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09473)
*Xudong Mou,Tiejun Wang,Rui Wang,Hui Wang,Pin Liu,Tianyu Wo,Xudong Liu,Renyu Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出时间序列异常检测中的"时序变化消歧"问题，并给出MORA框架：通过短/长期双视图重建同一局部目标，以重建差距衡量上下文支持度，并以数据依赖的校正机制保守地调整局部异常分数，从而区分分布漂移与真实异常，无需漂移标注或在线自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳环境下，分布漂移与真实异常都会造成相似的局部变化，导致难以判断某一偏差是异常还是情境演化。现有方法或对检测到的漂移进行适应，或学习对漂移不敏感的表征，但都未真正消解这一歧义。

Method: 将问题形式化为"时序变化消歧"：判断局部偏差能否由更广的时序演化解释。提出MORA框架，从配对的短期与长期视图重建同一局部目标，用重建差距度量上下文对该局部偏差的支持程度；并引入数据依赖的校正机制，保守地调整主局部异常分数——仅当上下文能改善对同一目标的重建时才允许降低分数。方法不需要漂移标注，也不需要在线自适应。

Result: 在四个TSAD基准上的实验表明，MORA对非平稳性具有较强鲁棒性，同时保持对真实异常的敏感性。

Conclusion: MORA从"同一目标、双视图重建"的角度重新框定漂移鲁棒性问题，把上下文作为可验证的证据来源而非盲目抑制信号，在无需额外标注与在线适配的条件下兼顾鲁棒性与敏感性。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) identifies deviations from patterns learned from historical data. In non-stationary settings, distribution drift and true anomalies can cause similar local changes, making it difficult to tell whether a deviation reflects abnormality or evolving context. Existing methods typically adapt to detected shifts or learn drift-insensitive representations, but do not resolve this ambiguity. We define this problem as \emph{temporal change disambiguation}: determining whether a local deviation is explained by broader temporal evolution. We introduce MORA, a drift-robust TSAD framework that reconstructs the same local target from paired short- and long-term views. The reconstruction gap measures contextual support for a local deviation, and a data-dependent correction mechanism conservatively adjusts the primary local anomaly score. Context can only reduce the score when it improves reconstruction of the same target. MORA needs neither drift annotations nor online adaptation. Experiments on four TSAD benchmarks show strong robustness to non-stationarity while preserving sensitivity to genuine anomalies.

</details>


### [309] [Safe on Average, Unsafe in the Tail: When Is the Episodic-Cost Tail Controllable?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09508)
*Samuel Tetteh,Cody Fleming*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 安全强化学习通常约束期望回合代价并以平均回合代价进行评测，这无法刻画代价在回合间的分布，可能遗漏最差回合的尾部违规。本文以 CVaR_{0.1}（最差10%回合的平均代价）度量回合代价尾部，定义"尾部安全"为 CVaR_{0.1} 处于安全预算内，据此识别"平均安全但尾部不安全"的策略，并评估在保持回报的前提下控制尾部违规的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全强化学习方法多数将约束施加在期望回合代价上，标准评测也只报告平均回合代价，不刻画代价在回合间的分布。因此，满足均值约束的策略在最差回合中仍可能不安全，而均值报告既无法揭示这种尾部违规，也无法说明能否在不牺牲回报的情况下将尾部代价控制到预算内。

Method: 用 CVaR_{0.1}（最差10%回合的平均代价）度量回合代价尾部；将 CVaR_{0.1} 在安全预算内的策略定义为尾部安全。实验方面：在三个 Safety-Gymnasium 导航任务上评测五种标准算法以识别尾部不安全策略；随后在密集危险导航中考察四类约束族；并在四个导航任务和四个运动（locomotion）任务上评估尾部控制效果。

Result: 在 Safety-Gymnasium 三个导航任务中，五种标准算法存在"平均安全但尾部不安全"的策略；在密集危险导航中比较了四类约束族的尾部控制表现；并在导航与运动共八个任务上检验了尾部违规的可控性。

Conclusion: 仅用平均回合代价评测安全策略不足，需引入 CVaR_{0.1} 等尾部指标来刻画并评定尾部安全性；尾部违规在均值安全的策略中确实存在，且其可控性可通过不同约束族在保持回报的前提下加以研究。

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning seeks policies that maximize return while satisfying constraints on cumulative cost. Most methods impose these constraints on expected episodic cost. Consequently, standard evaluations report mean episodic cost without characterizing how cost is distributed across episodes. A policy that satisfies the mean-cost criterion may therefore remain unsafe in its worst episodes. Mean-cost reporting neither identifies this tail violation nor shows whether it can be brought within budget while preserving return. In this work, we measure the episodic-cost tail using $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.1}$, the average cost of the worst $10\%$ of episodes. We classify a policy as tail-safe when $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.1}$ is within the safety budget. This allows us first to identify policies that are safe on average but unsafe in the tail and then to study whether their tail violations can be controlled while preserving return. To identify tail-unsafe policies, we evaluate five standard algorithms on three Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks. We then examine four constraint families on dense-hazard navigation and assess tail control across four navigation and four locomotion tasks.

</details>


### [310] [Physics-Informed Neural Plasticity: PDE Solvers That Reshape Themselves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09510)
*Chun-Wun Cheng,Bingcheng Hu,Angelica I. Aviles-Rivero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"物理信息神经可塑性"范式与ReCAP方法，让PDE求解器的表征在训练中动态重塑容量，在5个3D/4D基准上相对L2误差最低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物理信息神经PDE求解器的表征结构在训练中固定不变，与空间、时空上复杂度高度异质的PDE解不匹配：物理困难处容量不足，简单处容量冗余。

Method: 提出物理信息神经可塑性范式，表征随未解物理而重塑；实例化为ReCAP——高斯局部化求解器，通过局部增密、残差导向分裂、门控剪枝、函数感知合并动态重分配容量；用责任加权误差指标与残差能量几何决定细化位置与方式；引入quiet-child refinement，通过迁移父表征并控制瞬时函数扰动来初始化新分量；并给出条件性后验可靠性与结构稳定性保证。

Result: 在5个3D与4D PDE基准上对比11种物理信息求解器，ReCAP在每个问题上取得最低相对L2误差，较最强对比结果降低10.7%–27.5%。

Conclusion: 物理信息求解器不必仅学习参数，还可学习其表征容量应如何组织。表征结构的自适应重塑是提升PDE求解精度与效率的有效方向。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural PDE solvers adapt their parameters to satisfy governing equations, yet their representational structure typically remains fixed throughout training. This rigidity is poorly matched to PDE solutions with strongly heterogeneous complexity across space and space--time, leaving capacity insufficient where the physics is difficult and redundant where it is simple. We introduce physics-informed neural plasticity, a paradigm in which the representation itself reshapes during optimization in response to unresolved physics. We instantiate this principle with Representation Capacity Adaptation for PDEs (ReCAP), a Gaussian-localized solver that dynamically redistributes capacity through local enrichment, residual-directed splitting, gate-based pruning, and function-aware merging. ReCAP uses responsibility-weighted error indicators and the geometry of residual energy to determine where and how to refine. To limit the disturbance introduced by splitting, we introduce quiet-child refinement, which initializes new components by transporting the parent representation while controlling instantaneous functional perturbation. We further establish conditional a posteriori reliability and structural-stability guarantees linking localized physics residuals to solution error and stable refinement. Across five challenging 3D and 4D PDE benchmarks against 11 physics-informed solvers, ReCAP achieves the lowest relative $L^2$ error on every problem, reducing error by $10.7\%$--$27.5\%$ relative to the strongest competing result. These results suggest that physics-informed solvers need not merely learn their parameters---they can learn how their representational capacity should be organized.

</details>


### [311] [Differential Refresh Policies for Models Trained on Lagging Data Snapshots: From a Single-Age Equivalence Limit to an Optimal Per-Segment Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09519)
*Amit Rajula*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将"何时重训模型"重新表述为刷新预算分配问题：证明全局陈旧度触发器等价于校准均匀计时器，提出按段差异化刷新，并给出最优刷新率正比于风险平方根的最优策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产ML模型是基于时间受限训练快照的派生工件，部署即老化。现有做法用加权陈旧度分数触发的自适应重训取代固定周期，但作者认为"触发器/评分"是错误的杠杆，真正有效的是"动作"即刷新资源的分配方式。

Method: 理论证明等价性极限：任何关于单一共享全局训练数据年龄的静态严格单调刷新触发器，都等价于一个校准的均匀年龄计时器，故全局陈旧度预算不携带时钟以外信息。由此提出差异化刷新各段（增量训练或按段建模使成本可分离），并求解预算分配问题，用Cauchy-Schwarz给出均匀性代价的闭式解；再用真实泊松变化事件的离散事件仿真验证。

Result: 频繁刷新机制下，各段最优刷新率正比于其风险w_j λ_j的平方根，最优策略成本不超过均匀计时器，优于其的程度由闭式"均匀性代价"刻画，同质负载下为零、随异质性增大。仿真显示匹配预算下最优策略将实际加权陈旧暴露降低8-29%，在86-100%随机种子上胜出；朴素暴露阈值策略无此效果，说明增益来自分配而非评分；优势在50%速率估计噪声下仍保持。

Conclusion: 模型刷新的杠杆不在于更好的评分，而在于更好的动作。应放弃全局陈旧度触发器，转而采用按段差异化、风险平方根加权的刷新率分配策略。

Abstract: Production machine-learning models are derived artifacts of time-bounded training snapshots: a deployed model is a materialized view over a training cut that ages the instant it is built. A common response is to replace the fixed retraining cadence with an adaptive trigger -- a weighted staleness score that retrains when accumulated source risk crosses a threshold. We show this is the wrong lever, and identify the right one. First, an equivalence limit: any refresh trigger that is a static, strictly monotone function of a single shared global training-data age is operationally equivalent to a calibrated uniform age timer, so a global staleness budget, however elaborately it weights segments, sources, and sensitivities, carries no scheduling information a clock does not. The limit also shows how to escape it: refresh segments differentially, giving each its own age and refresh interval, which is meaningful when refresh cost is separable across segments (incremental training or per-segment models). We solve the resulting budget-allocation problem. In the frequent-refresh regime each segment's optimal refresh rate is proportional to the square root of its risk $w_j λ_j$ (weight times change rate), and the optimal policy never costs more than the uniform timer, beating it by a closed-form Cauchy-Schwarz "price of uniformity" that is zero for homogeneous workloads and grows with heterogeneity. In a discrete-event simulation with real Poisson change events, the optimal policy lowers realized weighted stale exposure by 8-29% relative to the uniform timer at matched refresh budget, winning on 86-100% of seeds; a naive exposure-threshold policy does not, showing the allocation is what helps; and the advantage survives 50% rate-estimation noise. The leverage in model refresh is not a better score but a better action.

</details>


### [312] [YANchor-4B: Effective Long-Horizon Reasoning in O(N) Time with O(1) Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10118)
*Huishan Ji,Hua Xu,Weiming Zhang,Qirui Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: YANchor-4B是一种通用循环模型，将关键记忆以"锚点"(ANchors)形式保留并在后续推理中检索，在O(N)时间生成与O(1)内存约束下实现高效长程推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程推理需要在可控生成成本下访问早期信息：全历史注意力带来存储与计算量的持续增长，而循环压缩会丢失精确细节，两者难以兼顾效率与保真度。

Method: 提出YANchor-4B通用循环模型，通过多维记忆机制将关键记忆保存为锚点(ANchors)，供后续推理阶段检索复用，同时保持O(N)时间生成和O(1)内存。

Result: 在AIME 2024--2026上取得82.93%平均pass@1，HMMT上达63.64%，显著优于线性时间、常数状态的同类模型（含更大规模模型）；在H100上批量长文本生成吞吐量较Transformer及混合基线高出数倍；在数十个基准上验证了通用能力优势。

Conclusion: YANchor以锚点式多维记忆在恒定内存与线性时间下兼顾长程推理精度与效率，性能超越更大规模的高效基线，并在通用能力上表现优越。

Abstract: Long-horizon reasoning demands access to earlier information at a manageable generation cost. Full-history attention incurs growing storage and computation, while recurrent compression can lose precise details. Therefore, we present YANchor-4B, a general-purpose recurrent model that preserves crucial memory as ANchors for retrieval during subsequent reasoning. Beyond $O(N)$-time generation and $O(1)$ memory, YANchor enables effective long-horizon reasoning through its multidimensional memory mechanism. For example, on challenging math problems, it achieves 82.93% mean pass@1 on AIME 2024--2026 and 63.64% on HMMT, substantially outperforming linear-time, constant-state counterparts, including larger models. It also delivers several-fold higher batched long-generation throughput than Transformer and hybrid baselines on H100. Furthermore, evaluations across dozens of benchmarks demonstrate YANchor's superiority in general-purpose capabilities.

</details>


### [313] [Align Before You Combine: Reference Space Calibration for Supervision Without Ground Truth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09525)
*Jackson Eshbaugh,Jorge Silveyra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种"校准优先"的无标签融合框架，通过合成的有序参考空间对齐各子集评分器，在三个基准数据集上一致优于未校准平均与最佳单一评分器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在既无真值标签、又无共享标注空间的场景下，不同子集训练出的评分器输出尺度互不可比，无法直接融合为统一的监督分数。传统校准方法依赖标注数据或共享标注空间，因此需要一种与训练集经验分布无关的校准方式。

Method: 框架先构建一个合成的有序参考空间：由代表潜在概念的有序校准特征组成，作为公共尺度；在校准阶段仅使用该参考空间而非训练样本，从而与训练集的经验分布解耦。之后将各子集专属评分器的输出在该参考空间上对齐，再进行融合，得到无需真值标签的监督分数。研究还考察了降低每个特征的校准层级数对结果的影响。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上，该框架一致优于未校准平均，并在主要评价指标上的点估计高于最佳单一评分器。与依赖样本的基线相比，性能差异随领域变化：Ames Housing 上绝对差小于 0.02，Breast Cancer Wisconsin 与 Wine Quality 上小于 0.01。经 Bonferroni 校正后，Ames Housing 的三项比较以及 Breast Cancer Wisconsin 的一项比较仍保持显著。此外，减少每个特征的校准层级可在大幅降低计算成本的同时近似高分辨率结果。

Conclusion: 结果表明，当既无真值标签也无共享标注空间时，该校准优先框架是构建监督分数的一条可行途径；其校准过程独立于训练集经验分布，并可通过降低校准分辨率实现计算成本与精度的折中。

Abstract: We introduce a calibration-first framework that produces supervision scores without access to ground-truth labels or a shared annotation space. Our framework aligns subset-specific scorers using a synthetic ordinal reference space before fusion. This reference space is constructed from ordered calibration features that represent the latent concept, providing a common scale on which otherwise incomparable scorer outputs can be aligned. Because our calibration procedure uses the reference space rather than training samples, it is independent of the training set's empirical distribution. Across three benchmark datasets, our framework consistently outperforms uncalibrated averaging and achieves higher primary-metric point estimates on the evaluation metrics than the best individual scorer. Performance relative to sample-dependent baselines varies by domain, with absolute differences below 0.02 on Ames Housing and below 0.01 on Breast Cancer Wisconsin and Wine Quality. After Bonferroni correction, differences remain significant for all three comparisons on Ames Housing and one on Breast Cancer Wisconsin. Additionally, we show that using fewer calibration levels per feature can closely approximate higher-resolution results at substantially lower computational cost. Together, these results support our framework as a viable approach to construct supervision scores when neither ground-truth labels nor a shared annotation space is available.

</details>


### [314] [CircuitGate: Logic-Consistent Circuit-Level Functional Modeling for And-Inverter Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09549)
*Qifan Zhang,Ruijie Li,Fangzhou Zhang,Qian Ma,Hui Li,Furui Zhan,Yongpeng Wang,Liying Hao,Shikai Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CircuitGate，一种函数感知的AIG表征学习框架，从门级语义迈向电路级功能建模，在等价门识别与信号概率预测任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AIG表征学习多基于GNN，依赖局部门级消息传递，难以捕捉电路级功能上下文，且对拓扑特定模式敏感，表征鲁棒性不足。

Method: CircuitGate显式编码全局主输入（PI）支撑集，建模扇入间支撑重叠感知的重汇聚关系，并引入逻辑启发的布尔约束以促使表征功能一致。

Result: 在ForgeEDA大规模基准上评测，并在EPFL与ITC'99上验证；等价门识别与信号概率预测任务中持续超越现有方法，MAE分别最多降低21.7%与14.2%；在ForgeEDA到OpenABC直接迁移（无微调）下取得最佳等价门识别性能。

Conclusion: 结果表明，超越局部拓扑、建模电路级功能依赖是有效的，且具备强跨数据集泛化能力。

Abstract: And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs) are fundamental representations for logic synthesis and verification in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). As structured representations of complex digital systems, AIGs require models to capture functional dependencies beyond local structure and remain robust to functionality-preserving transformations. In learning-based AIG representation, existing approaches are predominantly based on GNNs and rely on local gate-level message passing, limiting their ability to capture circuit-level functional context and making the learned representations sensitive to topology-specific patterns. Therefore, we propose CircuitGate, a function-aware AIG representation learning framework that advances from gate-level semantics to circuit-level functional modeling. CircuitGate explicitly encodes global primary-input (PI) support and models support-overlap-aware reconvergence between fanins, while incorporating logic-inspired Boolean constraints to encourage functionally consistent representations. We evaluate CircuitGate on the large-scale ForgeEDA benchmark and further validate it on the EPFL and ITC'99 benchmarks. Across equivalent-gate identification and signal-probability prediction tasks, CircuitGate consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 21.7% and 14.2% reductions in MAE, respectively. Under direct ForgeEDA-to-OpenABC transfer without fine-tuning, CircuitGate also achieves the best equivalent-gate identification performance, demonstrating strong cross-dataset generalization. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of modeling circuit-level functional dependencies beyond local topology.

</details>


### [315] [From Prompts to Trees: Effective LLM-Guided Tree Generation for Few-Shot Tabular Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10227)
*Yue Qiu,Zekang Du,Yiqun Diao,Bingsheng He,Qinbin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将大语言模型(LLM)知识蒸馏为可解释决策树的框架，在少样本表格分类中通过三阶段提示范式生成规则并组织成树，兼顾精度、可解释性与低提示开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM具备丰富世界知识与泛化能力，但直接用于表格数据分类存在推理成本高、可解释性差的问题；决策树虽快速透明，却在低数据场景下表现不佳。因此需要一种能融合二者优势的方法。

Method: 在少样本学习设定下，将LLM知识蒸馏到可解释决策树中。不直接提示LLM生成完整树（不稳定且低效），而是采用三阶段范式：提示LLM生成规则，再将规则组织为决策树。

Result: 在多个真实世界表格数据集上的实验表明，相比现有基线，本方法在显著降低提示开销的同时取得了更优的准确率和可解释性。

Conclusion: 该框架有效弥合了LLM与决策树两种范式，在少样本表格分类任务中实现了精度、可解释性与效率的平衡。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) possess rich world knowledge and impressive generalization capabilities, their direct application to tabular data classification is hindered by high inference costs and limited interpretability. In contrast, decision trees are fast and transparent but often underperform in low-data regimes. In this work, we propose a novel framework that bridges these paradigms by distilling LLM knowledge into interpretable decision trees under a few-shot learning setting. Instead of directly prompting the LLM to generate full trees, which is often unstable and inefficient, we develop a three-stage paradigm that prompts the LLM to generate rules and organize the rules into a tree. Experiments on multiple real-world tabular datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy and interpretability with significantly lower prompting overhead compared to existing baselines.

</details>


### [316] [A Framework for the Systematic Review of ML Assets in AI Registries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09551)
*Alexandra González,Quim Motger,Xavier Franch,Silverio Martínez-Fernández*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将系统综述方法从科学文献迁移到AI注册库，把ML资产（预训练模型、数据集、基准）视为一等分析单元，提出覆盖规划、执行、记录三阶段的ML资产系统化检索框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代软件系统日益依赖ML资产进行构建、评估与集成，但当前ML资产的探索、选择与复用缺乏类似传统证据综合的系统化检索方法。实践中资产选择常被当作既定设计决策，仅有非正式理由支撑，缺乏可追溯、基于证据且可更新的选择过程，因此选择过程不透明、不可复现。研究目标是探索系统综述方法如何支持ML资产检索，使选择透明、可复现并更好匹配预期用途。

Method: 分析科学文献中成熟的系统综述实践，将其阶段（规划、执行、文档记录）适配到AI注册库场景，把ML资产视为一等分析单元。所提框架整合三类机制：注册库感知的检索策略、跨注册库的schema对齐、依赖驱动的ML资产探索。

Result: 将ML资产检索概念化为系统化、可复现的过程而非临时性活动，并提出面向结构化ML资产发现的框架；同时论证系统综述原则可超越科学文献，用于支撑不断演化的AI注册库上的证据综合。

Conclusion: 系统综述原则可扩展至科学文献之外的AI注册库，为ML资产选择提供透明、可复现、基于证据且可更新的检索与证据综合途径。

Abstract: Background: Modern software systems increasingly rely on Machine Learning (ML) assets (i.e., pre-trained models, datasets, benchmarks) for building, evaluating, and integrating ML-based systems. However, current exploration, selection and reuse practices of ML assets are not supported by systematic retrieval methodologies comparable to those used in traditional evidence synthesis. Consequently, in practice, ML asset selection is often presented as a settled design decision, supported by informal justification rather than a traceable, evidence-based, and updatable selection process. Aims: This paper explores how systematic review methods can support ML asset retrieval. In doing so, we aim to make their selection transparent and reproducible, grounded in explicit evidence, and ultimately better suited to its intended use. Method: We analyze established systematic review practices from scientific literature and adapt their phases (i.e., planning, conducting, and documenting) to Artificial Intelligence (AI) registries, treating ML assets as first-class units of analysis. The resulting framework integrates registry-aware search strategies, cross-registry schema alignment, and dependency-driven ML asset exploration. Results: We conceptualize ML asset retrieval as a systematic and reproducible process rather than an ad hoc activity, and propose a framework for structured ML asset discovery. \textbf{Conclusions:} This work illustrates how systematic review principles can be extended beyond scientific literature to support evidence synthesis over evolving AI registries.

</details>


### [317] [PatchBench: Measuring Collateral Damage in Activation Patching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10276)
*Alexi Canesse,Mathis Le Bail,Maël Jenny,Clément Elliker,Mahammed El Sharkawy,Sonia Vanier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 PatchBench 基准与 PatchBench-Local 评估协议，用于区分"选择性修复"与"局部过度抑制"，揭示聚合指标掩盖的越狱修复附带损伤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 安全补丁可能通过基准测试却仍是劣质修复：或只挡住 exact evaluation prompts 而在近似有害变体上失效，或通过过度拒答良性提示来"压制"有害行为。现有协议侧重测试模型能否被攻破，而 attack success、refusal rates、global capability 等聚合指标无法区分选择性修复与更宽泛的局部抑制，存在评估盲区。

Method: 构建 PatchBench：从 37 个公开数据集的 27,870 条提示出发，整理 15,314 条英文提示，查询 8 个开源 instruction-tuned 模型，结合 WildGuard 过滤、pairwise Elo 排序与人工核验，得到 400 条高置信越狱失败样本库。进一步提出 PatchBench-Local 评估协议：针对每个有害源提示生成三类局部邻居——保留恶意意图的有害变体、结构匹配的良性提示、复用关键有害词的良性提示，分别评估有害邻居纠正率与良性邻居保持率。用该协议与 MMLU 评估四种 activation steering 方法。

Result: 实验显示，四种 activation steering 方法在 MMLU 上全局能力几乎不变，但局部良性回归严重，证明聚合指标会遗漏重要的附带损伤。

Conclusion: PatchBench-Local 能识别仅靠聚合指标无法发现的局部副作用，为越狱修复方法的开发与比较提供了更精确的评估基础。

Abstract: An LLM safety patch can pass a benchmark while still being a poor repair. This risk is especially acute for jailbreak repairs, where the goal is to correct a specific unsafe behaviour without changing unrelated behaviours. A patch may block exact evaluation prompts yet fail on close harmful variants, or suppress harmful behaviour by over-refusing benign prompts that share its wording or structure. Existing protocols primarily test whether models can be broken, while aggregate metrics (attack success, refusal rates, global capability) cannot distinguish selective repairs from broader local suppression. To address this gap, we introduce PatchBench, a benchmark of empirically observed model-specific jailbreak failures inducing actionable harmful answers. Starting from 27,870 prompts from 37 public datasets, we curate 15,314 English prompts and query 8 open-source instruction-tuned models. Combining WildGuard filtering, pairwise Elo ranking, and manual verification, we retain a curated bank of 400 high-confidence jailbreak failures. We further introduce PatchBench-Local, an evaluation protocol testing whether a patch is behaviourally precise. For each harmful source prompt, PatchBench-Local generates three families of local neighbours: harmful variants preserving malicious intent, benign prompts with matched structure, and benign prompts reusing key harmful terms. It evaluates harmful-neighbour correction and benign-neighbour preservation, distinguishing selective repair from broader local suppression. Evaluating four activation steering methods with PatchBench-Local and MMLU shows that global capability can remain nearly unchanged while local benign regressions are severe, confirming aggregate metrics miss important collateral damage. PatchBench-Local provides a more precise basis for developing and comparing jailbreak repair methods.

</details>


### [318] [UniCSI Towards a Universal Wi-Fi CSI Encoder for Ubiquitous Human Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09559)
*Daniel Eckhoff,Hua Kang,Zhitang Chen,Jie Chuai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 UniCSI，一种直接处理异构 CSI 的统一基础架构，通过物理信息 RF tokenizer 和频谱聚合器保留原生波形完整性，在 25 个异构公开数据集上显著提升跨域迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wi-Fi 感知有望将日常无线信号变为普适人体感知传感器，但 CSI 采集受设备配置影响（子载波数、带宽、频段不同），导致 CSI 张量在频谱分辨率和形状上差异巨大，异构建模困难。标准架构难以应对这种异构性，被迫采用有损预处理，损害原始信号。

Method: UniCSI 包含两项核心创新：(1) 物理信息 RF tokenizer，依据每个频率通道在物理频谱中的分数位置而非固定数组索引进行编码，保留内在频谱相干性，实现与频率分辨率无关的任意配置处理；(2) 频谱聚合器，将变长通道序列蒸馏为固定长度频谱签名，将特征维度与物理子载波间隔解耦。

Result: 在 25 个异构公开数据集（14 至 2048 个子载波、20 至 160 MHz 带宽、2.4 与 5 GHz 频段）的大规模语料上评估，原生异构输入在监督与自监督训练下均显著改善跨域迁移，尤其在固定网格架构无法泛化的场景中表现突出。

Conclusion: UniCSI 通过原生异构 CSI 处理，克服了传统固定网格架构的局限，为跨配置、跨域 Wi-Fi 感知提供了统一且可泛化的基础架构。

Abstract: Wi-Fi sensing promises to turn the everyday wireless signals that already surround us into ubiquitous sensors for human sensing. However, a fundamental obstacle is that CSI is acquired under diverse device-specific configurations, including different subcarrier counts, bandwidths, and carrier bands. Consequently, the resulting CSI tensors vary in both spectral resolution and tensor shape, making heterogeneous modeling challenging. Standard architectures struggle with such heterogeneity, forcing lossy pre-processing which compromises the underlying signal. To bridge this gap, we present UniCSI, a unified foundation architecture that directly operates on heterogeneous CSI while preserving the integrity of the native waveform. UniCSI hinges on two core innovations: (1) a physics-informed RF tokenizer that encodes each frequency channel based on its fractional position within the physical spectrum rather than rigid array indices. It preserves intrinsic spectral coherence and enables seamless, frequency resolution-agnostic processing across arbitrary sensing configurations. (2) a spectral aggregator that distills variable-length channel sequences into a fixed-size spectral signature, effectively decoupling the feature dimensionality from the physical subcarrier spacing. Extensive evaluations on a large-scale corpus of 25 heterogeneous public datasets, spanning 14 to 2048 subcarriers, 20 to 160 MHz bandwidth, and the 2.4 and 5 GHz bands, demonstrate that native heterogeneous ingestion substantially improves cross-domain transfer under both supervised and self-supervised training schemes, particularly in regimes where fixed-grid architectures fail to generalize.

</details>


### [319] [SemanticFold: Latent Sequence Compression SeparatesLanguage Modeling, Decodability, and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10304)
*Mingyan Liu,Min Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出前缀隐状态的语义折叠压缩方案 SemanticFold，并在五种模型规模、五类评估端点上检验压缩是否保留语言模型推理能力，结论是压缩效果非单调且不存在单一标量"证书"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究提示前缀的隐序列压缩是否会破坏大模型推理所依赖的能力。既有工作多以单一指标判断压缩是否"无损"，但语言模型拟合、可解码性与推理行为可能在被测压缩操作下向不同方向变化，因此需要一个统一协议来分离目标选择等混淆因素，并系统检验多端点表现。

Method: 提出 SemanticFold：在学习到的边界处折叠前缀隐状态。在 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-8B、SmolLM2-1.7B、Pythia-1.4B、Pythia-6.9B 五种规模上评估采用固定目标协议：冻结前缀以原生或压缩方式执行，两条分支教师强制相同的续写 token，从而排除目标选择对似然变化的解释。评估五类端点：固定目标负对数似然、有限标签推理准确率、线性探针可访问性、开放式生成、系统级内存与延迟。另用 NLL 分解分离"序列缩短"与"学习到的残差变换"的贡献，并设 MLP-only（仅变换不缩短）对照。

Result: 压缩对各端点的影响非单调，且不存在统一的压缩阈值。Qwen3-1.7B 在压缩比 R=1.7 时，配对 bootstrap（10000 次抽样）下压缩减原生的平均 NLL 降低 0.135；SmolLM2 在 R=1.2 时平均变化比原生高 0.013；两个 Pythia  checkpoint 的 NLL 基本不变。NLL 分解表明，Qwen 的有利似然主要来自残差自适应而非单纯序列缩短；仅施加变换不缩短的 MLP-only 比完整 SemanticFold 的 NLL 低 0.082。线性探针准确率与 macro AUC 在各条件下绝对变化小于 0.03，置信区间跨越零。

Conclusion: 隐压缩下的"保真"不存在单一标量证书：语言模型拟合、可解码性与推理行为回答的是不同问题，且在同一压缩操作下可能朝不同方向变化，因此需多端点联合评估而非依赖单一指标。

Abstract: We study whether latent sequence compression of prompt prefixes preserves the capabilities that large language models rely on during inference. We introduce SemanticFold, a compression scheme that folds prefix hidden states at learned boundaries, and evaluate it across five model scales: Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-8B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Pythia-1.4B, and Pythia-6.9B. We use a fixed-target protocol: a frozen prefix is executed natively or compressed, and both arms teacher-force identical continuation tokens. This design rules out target-selection explanations for likelihood changes. We examine five endpoint families: fixed-target negative log-likelihood, finite-label reasoning accuracy, linear probe accessibility, open-ended generation, and systems-level memory and latency. We find that compression moves these endpoints non-monotonically and that they do not share a single compression threshold. On Qwen3-1.7B at compression ratio R=1.7, compressed-minus-native mean NLL decreases by 0.135 under paired bootstrap with 10000 draws. On SmolLM2 at R=1.2, the mean change is 0.013 higher than native. On both Pythia checkpoints, NLL is effectively unchanged. An NLL decomposition separating sequence shortening from the learned residual transform shows that the favorable Qwen likelihood is attributable primarily to residual adaptation rather than to shortening alone. MLP-only, which applies the transform without shortening, achieves 0.082 lower NLL than Full SemanticFold. Linear probe accuracy and macro AUC change by less than 0.03 in absolute value across conditions, with confidence intervals crossing zero. We conclude that preservation under latent compression has no single scalar certificate: language-model fit, decodability, and reasoning behavior answer different questions and can move in different directions under the same compression operation.

</details>


### [320] [EvoSignal: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Design of Modular Traffic Signal Control Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09563)
*Leizhen Wang,Peibo Duan,Zhenlin Qin,Yancheng Ling,Jian Xu,Yue Wang,Hao Wang,Zhenliang Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EvoSignal，将交通信号控制(TSC)建模为模块化程序设计问题，用LLM引导的进化框架结合交通知识与性能反馈自动生成可检查的控制程序，无需在线LLM推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有效TSC需响应变化的交通需求与网络条件并满足多目标，但现有策略适配依赖反复人工设计与调整，难以系统探索更优规则；直接用LLM选相位会将决策规则藏于黑箱，且带来持续的推理成本与延迟。

Method: 将TSC表述为模块化程序设计：分离交通特征提取、局部相位优先排序、可选的路网级优先级调整；从若干既有策略出发，利用交通知识与拥堵、信号运行性能反馈，通过LLM引导的进化改进程序，并保留具有不同性能权衡的策略。

Result: 在两个真实路网、五个场景的仿真中，选定的默认EvoSignal程序相比每个场景中20个基线（传统、强化学习、LLM类）达到的最低等待时间，进一步降低16.8–49.2%；一个侧重旅行时间与排队长度的程序在搜索场景三项指标上均超越全部20个基线，且原样迁移至其余四场景后每项指标仍居前三。

Conclusion: 支持自动设计可检查、可跨所评估路网与交通需求迁移的控制程序；程序运行阶段不依赖在线LLM推理。代码已开源。
